RESIDENCY FACULTY – HOMELESS HEALTHCARE FACULTY CHAMPION
  
  
**Job Description**
Through a recently awarded HRSA Primary Care Training and Enhancement (PCTE) grant, the Department of Family and Social Medicine is expanding its homeless healthcare education programs. Working closely with the Director of Homeless Healthcare Curriculum and residency leadership, the Faculty Champion will serve as a key member of the educational leadership team, advancing the integration of homeless healthcare throughout the residency curriculum through innovative clinical, educational, and community-based initiatives. This position offers substantial opportunities for professional growth through the development of educational programming, community partnerships, learner mentorship, faculty development, and educational scholarship.
  
  
Goals
  
  

- To provide Family Medicine residents with outstanding clinical education and mentorship in homeless healthcare and community-based primary care through compassionate, evidence-based, patient-centered care.
- To strengthen residency education through innovative curriculum development, experiential learning, and interdisciplinary partnerships focused on the care of people experiencing homelessness and other medically underserved populations.
- To advance the Department of Family and Social Medicine's mission of health equity by integrating homeless healthcare, social medicine, and structural competency into residency education, clinical care, scholarship, and community engagement.
- To serve as a clinician educator and role model who demonstrates excellence in teaching, professionalism, interdisciplinary collaboration, and trauma-informed care while fostering resident growth and lifelong learning.

**Faculty Activities Will Include But Not Be Limited To**

- Provide approximately four clinical sessions per week of direct patient care in supportive housing and other community-based homeless healthcare settings while supervising residents and learners in these environments.
- Provide approximately 2 clinical sessions per week of direct patient care at either the Family Health Center or Williamsbridge Family Practice.
- Participate in a shared, home-based telephone call schedule to support continuity of care for established clinic patients. Call responsibilities are limited in frequency, shared among faculty, and do not require in-person coverage.
- Provide one session per week of resident precepting within the Williamsbridge Family Practice Center, promoting high-quality ambulatory education and patient care.
- Supervise resident clinical experiences in supportive housing and other non-traditional healthcare settings, providing direct observation, formative feedback, and individualized coaching.
- Develop, implement, and evaluate educational experiences within the Montefiore-Einstein Family Medicine Residency Homeless Healthcare curriculum and the NYC Homeless Healthcare Fellowship.
- Develop and deliver didactic sessions on topics relevant to the care of marginalized populations.
- Mentor residents participating in the Homeless Healthcare Track and fellows enrolled in the NYC Homeless Healthcare Fellowship, supporting career development, scholarly activity, quality improvement initiatives, and professional growth.
- Collaborate with behavioral health providers, social workers, legal partners, community-based organizations, and other interdisciplinary professionals to develop meaningful clinical and educational experiences for residents.
- Participate in faculty development activities through the Clinician Educator Institute in Homeless Healthcare (CEIHH), while contributing to the development of faculty engaged in homeless healthcare education.
- Participate in program evaluation, quality improvement initiatives, and educational scholarship designed to strengthen homeless healthcare education and improve learner outcomes.
- Participate in residency educational conferences, faculty meetings, committee work, and other departmental activities as appropriate.
- Serve as a role model for interdisciplinary collaboration, professionalism, cultural humility, and patient-centered care while fostering an inclusive learning environment.

**Qualifications**

- MD or DO with board certification or board eligibility in Family Medicine.
- Eligible for unrestricted licensure in New York State.
- Demonstrated commitment to caring for medically underserved populations.
- Experience or strong interest in homeless healthcare, supportive housing, addiction medicine, street medicine, social medicine, or community-based primary care.
- Interest in graduate medical education, curriculum development, learner assessment, and faculty development.
- Excellent interpersonal, teaching, organizational, and collaborative skills.
- Commitment to interdisciplinary, team-based care and continuous quality improvement.

In addition to a generous salary of $200,000-210,000, we offer LTD, STD, paid malpractice, Dental, Health and Eye care among many more benefits.
  
  
Interested applicants should send CV and cover letter to: John C. Pinto, Senior Recruiter jpinto@montefiore.org
  
  
Please Note: At the conclusion of the grant, or in the event of changes to grant funding, the Department will work collaboratively with the faculty member to identify opportunities for continued employment within the Department of Family and Social Medicine, which may include a combination of ambulatory clinical practice, teaching, and precepting activities.

title: Director of Onboarding & Enablement (Remote)
description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien resolution process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

We are seeking a Director of Onboarding & Enablement to own how new customers, primarily in our Single Event lien resolution vertical, get from signed agreement to fully running on Zipliens, and to build the training and content library that makes that experience consistent at scale.

This is a founding role. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will own the design and execution of the new customer implementation experience end to end, along with every asset that supports it: internal training and certification, the external knowledge base, tutorial videos, deck content, one-pagers, and in-product guidance. Onboarding today runs on an undocumented framework and a capable team. What it does not yet have is a single owner, measured outcomes, or a content system that keeps pace with the product.

You will build that. You will also define what this function needs to become and make the hiring recommendations that get it there. This role suits someone who has done this before and can operate from a blank page without waiting for direction.

In your first year, you will focus on:

- Create a standard Onboarding framework and take it from a documented roadmap to a running program with named owners, stage gates, service commitments, and a measured time to value.
- Define distinct onboarding paths for standard, pilot, and custom engagements, aligned to how we package and sell.
- Build the customer-facing enablement library: knowledge base, tutorial videos, one-pagers, and training decks, with a governance model that keeps it current.
- Build the internal enablement curriculum and ramp plan for Customer Success Managers, Account Managers and cross-functional peers, including a defined competency bar.
- Instrument onboarding KPI’s: completion rates, time to first intake, training participation, and early adoption, reported on a set cadence.
- Recommend the structure, sequencing, and first hires for the Onboarding & Enablement function.

### Requirements

### Responsibilities:

Onboarding Program Ownership

- Program Design: Own the end-to-end new customer implementation experience, from signed agreement through steady state, including stage definitions, named owners on both sides, timelines, and service commitments.
- Execution Accountability: Run onboarding across the book of business, coordinating with Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, Operations Leads, and Product Support so every customer receives the same standard of experience.
- Path Differentiation: Define and maintain onboarding paths by package and segment, including pilots, custom engagements, cross-product deals, and vertical-specific structures such as Mass Tort matters and programs.
- Recovery Ownership: Identify onboardings trending off track and own the intervention, including root cause analysis that feeds back into program design.
- Early Risk & Strategic Alignment: Partner with leaders across Customer Success, Sales & Partnerships, Lien Resolution Operations, Product, and Finance to surface implementation risk early, while it is still correctable, and to align onboarding decisions with broader portfolio health and revenue-impacting strategy.

Enablement Content & Collateral

- External Content: Start and own the customer-facing knowledge base, tutorial and walkthrough video library, one-pagers, and training materials that support portal adoption and workflow best practices.
- Training Delivery: Own kickoff and training curriculum design, including live sessions, self-serve paths, and refresher training available for the life of the partnership.
- Internal Enablement: Build and maintain internal training, certification, and ramp materials for customer-facing teams, and identify capability gaps to fill through structured curriculum.
- Content Governance: Maintain a single source of truth for all enablement content, with versioning, review cadence, named owners, and brand and voice continuity with marketing guides.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

- KPI Ownership: Define and report onboarding and enablement KPIs, including time to value, onboarding completion, training participation, content utilization, and early adoption.
- AI & Data Enablement: Leverage AI and data to optimize how onboarding runs and what it produces, using adoption, completion, and support signals to pinpoint where customers stall, then applying automation and AI-assisted content development to remove that friction and improve early customer outcomes.
- Feedback Loop: Own post-onboarding feedback collection and translate results into program changes rather than observations.
- Product Partnership: Surface onboarding and adoption friction to Product with supporting evidence, and advocate for changes that reduce implementation effort.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Sales & Business Development: Own the receiving end of the handoff, including the scope, success criteria, and customer context required for onboarding to start cleanly.
- Customer Success: Partner with the Director of Customer Success on the transition from onboarding to ongoing account management, ensuring nothing is dropped at the seam.
- Lien Resolution Operations: Partner with Single Event Operations so customer-facing training reflects how work actually moves through the operation.
- Marketing & Product Marketing: Partner with Marketing on brand, voice, and production standards for customer-facing collateral and video; partner with our Product Marketing Manager on strategies and content around new releases, value proposition, and objection handling.

Founding Responsibilities

- Function Design: Define what the Onboarding & Enablement function needs to be at our current scale and at our next one, and recommend structure, roles, and hiring sequence accordingly.
- Documentation: Build the documentation that lets the program run without depending on one person's memory.
- Scale Readiness: Design for extension into new verticals and business lines from the outset, so growth does not require rebuilding the program.

### Qualifications:

- 5+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, customer education, or enablement within B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services, including 3+ years owning a program end to end or leading a team.
- Demonstrated experience building an onboarding or implementation program from scratch, or materially rebuilding one, with measurable results.
- Hands-on content creation experience across formats: knowledge base articles, video tutorials, decks, one-pagers, and structured training curriculum.
- Experience driving adoption of a customer-facing portal or platform.
- Proven ability to run programs across teams that do not report to them, with clear ownership and follow-through.
- Proven ability to operate as a founding function owner, setting priorities independently and bringing forward recommendations rather than open questions.
- Proficiency with enablement and support tooling, such as knowledge base and help center platforms, video and screen capture tools, learning management systems, and CRM (e.g., HubSpot).
- Instructional design or adult learning experience is preferred.
- Bachelor's degree required. Focus in business, communications, education, or a related field is preferred.
- Experience in legal services, personal injury, or litigation-adjacent technology is preferred.
- Ability to travel up to 20%.

### Benefits

### Benefits

- Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
- Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
- Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
- Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
- Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options

This is a foundational, individual contributor (IC) role at a critical inflection point for the organization. In this position, the Head of Security & Risk will build and own the information security and enterprise risk management functions from the ground up.

Reporting directly to the Deputy Chief Operating Officer, the individual will serve as the organization's primary security authority—establishing the enterprise risk framework, driving information security compliance, leading incident response and security operations, and managing institutional due diligence requests. This role requires close collaboration across engineering, product, legal, business development, and operations teams to ensure a proactive, audit-ready, and defensible security posture.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Build and Own Enterprise Risk Management (ERM):** Design and execute an enterprise risk management program from scratch. Oversee security, operational, regulatory, and counterparty risks, including maintaining the risk register, leading annual risk assessments, performing scenario analyses, and establishing an escalation framework across all legal entities.
- **Lead Information Security Compliance & Certifications:** Drive the compliance certification roadmap across frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Direct non-technical workstreams, including policy drafting, auditor coordination, vendor risk evaluations, third-party SaaS reviews, and periodic access reviews to maintain continuous audit readiness.
- **Establish Security Operations & Response Frameworks:** Design and maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS), security policies, and incident response frameworks. Manage external security vendor relationships, lead tabletop exercises across Incident Response (IR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DR) scenarios, and select external security advisory firms for on-call support.
- **Manage Partner Information Security Due Diligence:** Act as the primary point of contact for institutional partner security due diligence and inbound questionnaires. Build and maintain a reusable compliance documentation package and collaborate with legal counsel on security representations within commercial agreements.
- **Drive Information Security Culture & Awareness:** Develop and own the security awareness training curriculum across all departments. Promote a proactive security culture across engineering, product, legal, and operational units.

### Requirements

**Qualifications**

- **Experience:** 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, risk management, GRC, or compliance operations, ideally within fintech, digital asset/crypto infrastructure, or B2B SaaS sectors.
- **Compliance Expertise:** Demonstrated track record of building compliance programs from the ground up, including direct, hands-on ownership of full SOC 2 audits and ISO 27001 implementation/maintenance.
- **Technical & GRC Tooling:** Hands-on experience with modern GRC automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata), cloud environments (AWS preferred), and infrastructure security integration within DevOps/IaaS workflows.
- **Vendor & Audit Management:** Proven experience managing external audit relationships, penetration testing partners, and compliance vendors end-to-end.
- **Location:** Ability to work multiple days per week on-site in the primary hub located in New York City.

**Skills & Core Attributes**

- **Proactive Risk Mindset:** Ability to evaluate risks through likelihood, impact, and mitigation, translating technical and regulatory complexities into clear, business-focused solutions.
- **Process Rigor & Documentation:** Exceptional organizational skills with a strong focus on maintaining pristine documentation, evidence collection, and tracking systems.
- **High Ownership & Adaptability:** A self-starter capable of navigating ambiguity, driving end-to-end projects, and balancing strategic planning with tactical execution.
- **Strong Stakeholder Communication:** Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, legal, product, and business units by promoting security as a shared operational standard.

**Preferred / Nice to Haves**

- **Certifications:** Professional security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CySA+, or Cloud+.
- **Digital Asset Familiarity:** Experience with digital assets, stablecoins, smart contract security risks, and on-chain monitoring tools (e.g., Chainalysis, BlockAid).
- **Regulatory Knowledge:** Exposure to emerging digital asset frameworks such as the GENIUS Act, MiCA, DORA, or global financial services regulations.
- **Multi-Entity Structure:** Prior experience operating within multi-entity corporate structures (e.g., US entities, Cayman HoldCos, Swiss Foundations).

### Benefits

- **Competitive Compensation:** Market-leading base salary with equity/token grant participation tailored to experience.
- **Flexible Work Model:** Access to global team flexibility with dedicated hub offices in New York City and Berlin.
- **Comprehensive Healthcare & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health insurance coverage, a wellness allowance, and sponsored gym access.
- **Custom Hardware & IT Allowance:** Access to top-tier IT equipment and flexible workspace customization.
- **Professional Growth:** Dedicated annual learning and development budget covering industry conferences, certifications, and international company retreats.

title: Director, Product Marketing
description:
## **The Mission**

As Director of Product Marketing, you define how SalesRabbit wins in the market. You translate a complex, multi-product portfolio across SalesRabbit, Roofle, RoofLink, RoofRabbit, financing, billing, and future platform capabilities into clear positioning and a differentiated commercial story. You establish who each product serves, why customers should choose it, and how the portfolio supports customer acquisition, adoption, and expansion.

You sit at the center of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, translating product strategy into commercial execution. You own positioning, messaging, product launch strategy, sales enablement and training, competitive intelligence, and customer adoption and expansion marketing. You lead Product Marketing’s contribution to pricing and packaging, bringing customer insight, value articulation, and commercial recommendations into decisions with Product, Finance, and go-to-market leadership.

You build the continuous launch and commercialization discipline required to bring an evolving portfolio to market. That includes defining the audience and value proposition, establishing go-to-market readiness, preparing sellers and customer-facing teams, coordinating launch execution, and measuring adoption after release. You also own the marketing strategy for upsell and cross-sell, identifying the customer needs, segments, use cases, and offers that create credible expansion opportunities.

You partner closely with Growth Marketing, which translates positioning and customer insight into acquisition campaigns, prospect lifecycle programs, ABM, and events. You work with Brand and Content to ensure storytelling and creative execution reflect the product’s value and differentiation. You partner deeply with Product to turn roadmap and product vision into commercialization plans that the broader organization can execute, while ensuring market feedback informs future decisions.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role. You will personally own critical Product Marketing work while building the team, processes, operating rhythms, and capabilities that allow the function to scale. You are responsible for ensuring customer, competitive, and market intelligence continuously informs how we position, launch, sell, and expand the portfolio. You must be able to challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and align teams around a clear commercial direction.

You use AI to accelerate customer and market research, competitive intelligence, message testing, enablement, and execution while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment. Your success is measured by launch effectiveness, seller readiness, win rates, sales velocity, product adoption, competitive performance, and the conversion and revenue contribution of customer expansion programs.

## **Who We Are**

Sales Rabbit is a software company built for roofing and field sales. It builds the tools contractors and reps use at the door, in the office, and on the job: to generate demand, sell, operate, and get paid. Those tools run from the first lead to the final payment, so the job doesn't get lost in between. They're designed to help contractors maximize their efficiency. We build software solutions that propel our customers' businesses forward: Roof Rabbit for roofing and Field Rabbit for everything else sold door-to-door.

Everything runs as one unified, AI-native platform, in a single flow from lead to cash. Our solution brings together AI canvassing, online estimates, instant quotes, territory mapping, scheduling, communication, weather data, proposals, financing, measurements, project management, material ordering, inspections, and payments.

We believe speed decides who wins in the field, and that belief changes how we build and operate. As a distributed team, we focus on moving faster, operating with greater agility, and using AI and automation as practical force multipliers. Our goal is simple: help contractors grow more efficiently while building a company that can learn, innovate, and deliver value faster.

## **What You’ll Own**

### **Portfolio Positioning and Commercial Strategy**

- Own positioning and messaging across products, bundles, audiences, and lifecycle stages.
- Define the relationship between individual product value propositions and the broader platform story, ensuring claims reflect actual capabilities and integration readiness.
- Establish who should buy each product, why it is differentiated, and when an upgrade, cross-sell, or migration creates value.
- Own Product Marketing’s commercialization strategy and contribute to the integrated company go-to-market plan.
- Develop a clear market point of view that helps buyers understand the problems we solve and why our approach is different.
- Partner on pricing and packaging through customer research, value insights, packaging recommendations, and ROI narratives.

### **Customer and Competitive Intelligence**

- Own Voice of Customer and market intelligence across customer discovery, win/loss analysis, buyer sentiment, competitive movement, adoption data, and field feedback.
- Translate research into specific recommendations that influence positioning, product decisions, launches, and commercial priorities.
- Establish a repeatable competitive intelligence program that equips customer-facing teams and informs leadership.
- Partner with Product throughout the lifecycle to validate customer value, positioning, and commercial readiness.
- Identify gaps between what customers need, what the product delivers, and how the company describes its value.

### **Product Launches and Commercialization**

- Own launch strategy and go-to-market readiness across new products, significant releases, and portfolio changes.
- Define launch audiences, value propositions, messaging, offers, enablement requirements, adoption plans, and success measures.
- Build a repeatable launch discipline with clear responsibilities, dependencies, milestones, and post-launch reviews.
- Coordinate execution across Product, Growth Marketing, Brand and Content, Sales, and Customer Success.
- Surface readiness gaps early and recommend changes to scope, sequencing, or launch plans.
- Measure adoption and commercial performance after launch and use the findings to improve subsequent execution.

Product owns product and release readiness. Product Marketing owns the commercial readiness required to introduce, sell, and support the offering.

### **Sales Enablement and Training**

- Build the enablement system that gives Sales clear messaging, demos, tools, competitive intelligence, and launch support.
- Own product and sales training, including value articulation, discovery support, use cases, objection handling, and competitive positioning.
- Establish seller proficiency expectations and assess whether training improves readiness and effectiveness.
- Keep enablement current as products, customer needs, and competitive conditions change.
- Partner with Sales leadership to reinforce adoption, coaching, and use of materials in live opportunities.

### **Customer Adoption and Expansion**

- Own the marketing strategy for customer adoption, upsell, cross-sell, and advocacy.
- Define eligible customer segments, expansion use cases, triggers, offers, messaging, and campaign plans.
- Partner with Customer Success to identify needs and opportunities and with Sales or account management to support assisted expansion.
- Build customer education, communications, references, and advocacy programs that strengthen adoption and commercial credibility.
- Evaluate total portfolio performance so growth in one product does not obscure lost value elsewhere.

Sales or account management owns assisted closing. Product and Customer Success share responsibility for adoption and retention.

### **Team Leadership and Operating Discipline**

- Establish the function before the full team is in place, then sequence the hiring of a Product Marketing Manager and a Customer Marketing Manager.
- Set priorities and standards for research, messaging, launches, enablement, and expansion programs.
- Personally lead the most consequential work while developing the team’s judgment and execution capabilities.
- Use specialist support deliberately where it adds expertise or capacity.
- Embed practical AI workflows across research, competitive intelligence, analysis, message development, and enablement.
- Communicate recommendations clearly and hold cross-functional teams to agreed launch and commercial commitments.

## **What We Are Looking For**

### **Required**

- 8+ years in B2B SaaS Product Marketing, with deep hands-on ownership of positioning, launches, enablement, customer insight, and commercialization.
- Experience building or significantly transforming Product Marketing in a high-growth environment.
- Demonstrated success establishing a repeatable launch and release discipline across multiple products or a rapidly evolving platform.
- A record of measurable impact on launch adoption, seller effectiveness, win rates, sales velocity, expansion, or revenue growth.
- Exceptional ability to translate complex products and technical capabilities into simple, differentiated customer value.
- Meaningful pricing and packaging experience, including research, value articulation, ROI narratives, and commercial recommendations.
- Experience positioning multiple products within a coherent portfolio or platform story.
- Demonstrated ownership of customer discovery, competitive research, win/loss analysis, and market validation.
- Experience designing and delivering product or sales training, with evidence that sellers used the work and improved their readiness or effectiveness.
- Experience developing upsell or cross-sell plays through customer segmentation, usage insights, and partnership with Sales and Customer Success.
- Proven ability to influence senior Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders in ambiguous environments.
- Ability to hire and develop talent, establish operating discipline, and personally execute high-impact work.
- Practical use of AI across research, competitive intelligence, analysis, messaging, enablement, and execution, with repeatable workflows you can demonstrate.

**Preferred**

- Experience in roofing, home services, construction technology, or field sales.
- Experience integrating acquired products into a coherent portfolio story.
- Experience commercializing products through both sales-led and product-led growth motions.
- Experience in founder-led, private-equity-backed, or significant transformation environments.

## **What Success Looks Like**

### Within the first six months:

- Clear positioning defines who each product serves, why it wins, and how it relates to the rest of the portfolio.
- Priority launches have documented audiences, messaging, readiness criteria, enablement, adoption plans, and measurement.
- Sellers have current materials and demonstrate proficiency in the product story, customer value, and priority objections.
- Customer and competitive insights regularly inform product and commercial decisions.
- Expansion audiences and plays are defined, with initial programs launched and measured.
- A phased hiring plan establishes clear responsibilities for Product Marketing and Customer Marketing.

### **KPIs**

- Launch adoption among intended customer segments.
- Launch readiness and milestone delivery.
- Seller readiness and proficiency.
- Enablement usage in relevant opportunities.
- Targeted win-rate and sales-velocity trends.
- Expansion-qualified opportunities.
- Expansion-play conversion and revenue contribution.

Revenue, adoption, and retention are shared business outcomes. Product Marketing is accountable for its contribution, with numerical targets established from the baseline and commercial plan.

## **Who Thrives Here**

At SalesRabbit, we hire for operating cadence and mindset. The people who do best here share a few things in common:

- Active Curiosity - You seek root causes before proposing solutions and stay ahead of industry trends and tools.
- Grit & Scrappiness - You roll up your sleeves on hard, ambiguous, unglamorous work. You build functions, systems, messaging, and operating models before asking for additional headcount or resources.
- Extreme Ownership - You take accountability for outcomes, proactively communicate blockers, and deliver with minimal oversight.
- Bias Toward Impact - You measure success by business outcome, not effort. You course-correct fast and without ego.
- Team-First Collaboration - You listen to understand, give credit generously, and push back when something is wrong - to protect the outcome, not win the argument. You create clarity where none exists.

## **Benefits**

- 20 days of PTO + 10 paid holidays
- Medical, Vision, Dental, Life Insurance
- 401(k) 100% matching up to 4% of salary
- Company phone plan covering service for employee and spouse/child

*SalesRabbit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.*

When you join Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, a part of the Spirax Group, you will be integrated into a cooperative and encouraging team, participate in challenging yet critical work, and experience ongoing growth opportunities to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website to learn more.
  
  
**Company Overview**
At Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, part of Spirax Group, we are driven by innovation and are dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is empowered to make a difference. As a world leader in manufacturing peristaltic pumps and associated fluid path technologies for the life sciences and process industries, we offer a wide range of products, including tubing, specialised filling systems and products for single-use applications.
  
  
Our shared Purpose is to create sustainable value for all our stakeholders as we engineer a more efficient, safer and sustainable world. Our technologies play an essential role in critical industrial processes and industrial equipment across industries as diverse as Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical & Biotechnology, Power Generation, Semiconductors and Healthcare. With customers in 116 countries, we provide the solutions that sit behind the production of many items used in daily life, from baked beans to mobile phones!
  
  
Our inclusive culture and Values, unites us, guides our decisions and inspires us everywhere that we operate. We support our colleagues to make their difference for each other as well as customers, communities, suppliers, our planet and shareholders by creating a truly equitable working environment where everyone feels included.
  
  
**Why Join Us**

- Work on high-impact, technically complex solutions across global industries
- Be part of a collaborative, people-first culture with strong internal mobility
- Access career growth and development opportunities, including leadership pathways
- Contribute to a company committed to inclusion, innovation, and sustainability

**This Role Will Focus On**
As the Senior Technical Specialist (STS) for Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, you will play a key leadership role in driving the growth and success of our overall customer experience in the USA by delivering world class technical support. Reporting to the Vice President of Life Sciences, you will work collaboratively with the local sales and operational teams to deliver exceptional customer solutions, support large projects, and strengthen partnerships with key customers. You will serve as an authority on product specification, project management, customer application solutions, and factory customization capabilities of each brand while ensuring technical resources on the operation team are fit for purpose to serve the life science market.
  
  
The primary responsibility of the STS will be to work with all functional groups throughout the Life Sciences division to help define, develop, and drive our technical expertise and engineering support structure. This role will be expected to build a strong network of key contacts within the engineering/design teams of our key customers, engineering firms, and consultancies. The STS will have responsibility for training these contacts on the unique technical value propositions to help influence their recommendations to their customers for specifying WMFTS products.
  
  
STS is expected to intimately know the technical capabilities of all WMFTS engineering resources, both local and global. You will remain up-to-date with on all developments related to products, services, and procedures to help WM Inc deliver unmatched service quality while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
  
  
In this high-impact role, you will also act as a thought leader, representing Watson-Marlow at industry events, building relationships with decision-makers, and serving as the authority on large project negotiations while aligning with the long-term goals of both our clients and the organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Large Project Technical Lead:**
Serve as the primary technical contact and facilitate the deliverables for both local and global large projects. Duties include creation and maintenance of documentation relating to the project, along with coordinating project expectations with the customer and WMFTS resources to help ensure all commitments are delivered on time.
  
  
**Technical Expertise:**
Be the recognised company expert in emerging technical trends, regulatory compliance, complimentary products, and competitive product capabilities to help inform our sales team on how to better position WMFTS products with their customers.
  
  
**Innovation and Improvement:**
Drive innovation by identifying gaps in our technical service portfolio and implementing best practices to improve the customer impact of WMFTS resources.Work with WMFTS factories to support customer requests for customization, testing requirements, and validating outcomes.Lead local support for new product innovation initiatives.
  
  
**Training and Support:**
Collaborate with the local sales, operations teams, and key customers to improve their overall technical knowledge through regular training sessions and field support.This includes onsite customer training, certified customer training, and supporting internal employee training opportunities.
  
  
**Strategic Planning:**
Collaborate with Application Engineering leadership to develop and implement annual strategic plans for delivering our engineering solutions to the market using available operations resources and factory support.Help manage customer expectations by clearly defining our capability and capacity to support customers to all internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Relationship Building:**
Build and maintain relationships with key industry contacts by understanding their needs and aligning our technical resources to provide solutions more effectively.
  
  
**Risk Management:**
Identify and mitigate risks associated with engineering and technical support, ensuring business continuity and long-term success.
  
  
**Networking:**
Attend and/or present at conferences and exhibitions to network and meet new contacts, expanding our reach and identifying potential business opportunities.
  
  
**Health & Safety:**
Ensure the business provides a consistently safe working environment for all colleagues, drive health and safety improvements, and monitor EHS performance.
  
  
**Governance:**
Comply with all aspect of the Spirax Group policies and procedure.
  
  
**Who You’ll Be Working With**
The Strategic Accounts function is pivotal to the continued delivery of services to our major customers. Success within this function requires strong partnership with our local Sales teams, Strategic Account peers in other locations.
  
  
**This is what you’ll need to be successful in this role**

- Strong knowledge of key customers and processes and applications within the Life Sciences sector including an expert understanding of the industry and market dynamics.
- Significant commercial management and Sales experience including Key Account or Large Customer management experience of large complex, global or multi-regional accounts.
- Contract reviews/negotiation experience and awareness of contractual principles and risks.
- Proven ability to lead, grow and develop high performance teams, Ideally in a regional role.
- Ability to generate followership across regional, multifunctional departments; ideally within a similar corporate organisation.
- Cultural and regional awareness with the ability to work across countries and cultures, ideally working with a similar multinational manufacturer.

**Physical Demands**
Mobility: This is a remote position that primarily requires sitting at a desk or computer workstation for extended periods, with occasional need to stand or move around to maintain health and well-being. Ability to regularly operate a computer keyboard and mouse.
  
  
Vision and Hearing: Ability to use a computer and read documents. Effective communication skills to interact with colleagues and clients through video conferencing tools.
  
  
Dexterity: Basic hand dexterity for typing and using computer peripherals
  
  
Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
This position offers a salary range of USD 104,076.00 - 156,115.00 per year. Final salary offers are determined by multiple factors, including education, experience, internal equity, geographic location, and the candidate’s expertise, and therefore may vary from the range listed. For roles based outside Massachusetts, the applicable salary range may be lower.
  
  
**At Watson-Marlow, we believe in taking care of our colleagues. We offer a generous benefits package, including:**

- Robust Retirement Plan: Benefit from a 5% employer 401K contribution, plus a 50% match on up to 3% of your contributions for added financial security, empowering your financial security.
- Comprehensive and Supportive Parental Leave: Experience our inclusive, gender-neutral parental leave policy, offering 16 weeks at 100% pay. Upon your return, enjoy a gradual transition with a unique 80% work schedule while still receiving 100% of your pay for the first 6 months, ensuring a balanced reintegration into the workplace.
- Fertility Assistant Program: Fertility Benefits to support you on your journey to building a family. It may include IVF, genetic testing, and other fertility-related services.
- Generous Time Off: Enjoy ample time off to recharge and attend to life's circumstances with generous vacation and well-being day, 9 observed holidays, 1 floating holiday day, up to 15 caregiver days, and 80 hours of annual sick leave.
- Community Engagement Opportunities: Make a difference with 3 paid volunteer days each year, encouraging you to give back to the community and causes you care about.
- And Many More Benefits: Such as an offering of 3 healthcare plans with HSA contributions along with other benefits designed to support your well-being and professional growth. We invite you to explore all the ways we strive to create a fulfilling and rewarding work environment.

**Everyone is Included at Spirax Group**
We are passionate about creating inclusive and equitable working cultures where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. For us, that means supportive teams and strong relationships where everyone’s contribution is valued across social and cultural backgrounds, ethnicities, ages, genders, gender identities, abilities, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, and everything else that makes us human and unique.
  
  
We know that everyone needs some extra help from time to time, so we have introduced a range of additional benefits through our Group Inclusion Commitments. Learn more at Our Inclusion Commitments .

Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

PEAK 15 part of the Fullsteam organization is a growing software company that provides a cloud-based management system for the travel industry. Customers include Travel + Leisure World’s Best Award winners, National Geographic Expeditions, Micato Safaris, and Butterfield & Robinson, who use the platform to craft unique itineraries, process bookings, streamline operations, and manage customer and vendor relationships.

PEAK 15 is a collaborative and fast-paced work environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and development. We are a passionate team committed to customer success and growth, while promoting a positive work culture that values teamwork, transparency, and continuous improvement. PEAK 15 is a 100% remote workforce.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team and help ensure our customers derive maximum value from our products and services. As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of clients and play a key role in guiding customers from post-sale onboarding through go-live, product adoption, and long-term success. This role is responsible for helping customers achieve their business goals, driving effective onboarding and implementation milestones, and ultimately ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

The ideal candidate will possess a combination of excellent interpersonal skills, a strong customer-focused mindset, and the ability to proactively address challenges. This role is essential in fostering long-term relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and acting as the customer’s advocate within the organization.

This role also carries direct responsibility for managing newly onboarding customers through a structured onboarding process, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check-ins, go-live readiness, and follow-up on open action items to ensure a smooth transition into long-term customer success.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

- Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, building strong relationships and delivering a consistent, responsive customer experience from onboarding through ongoing account management.
- Guide newly onboarding customers through structured onboarding and implementation workflows, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check-ins, go-live readiness, documentation of next steps, and timely follow-up on open action items.
- Partner with Sales, Learning, Operations, Support, Product, Accounting, and business leadership to coordinate customer handoffs, resolve customer needs, and support timely follow-through on actions that contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.
- Monitor customer health, product adoption, account activity, and customer requests to identify potential retention risks, adoption barriers, or opportunities to improve the customer experience.
- Participate in periodic account health reviews with customers and internal stakeholders by helping document risks, opportunities, and follow-up actions.
- Support renewal and contract calendar management by tracking key dates, identifying upcoming customer or internal actions, and coordinating with responsible stakeholders.
- Coordinate customer issues that require support beyond standard troubleshooting by gathering relevant information, clarifying urgency and impact, and engaging the appropriate internal resources.
- Track customer issues through resolution, provide timely status updates, document outcomes, and ensure agreed-upon follow-up actions are completed.
- Support customer cancellation, transfer-of-ownership, and administrative account-change requests by collecting required information, coordinating with internal stakeholders, and following established documentation, approval, and handoff processes.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications, onboarding progress, account changes, approvals, effective dates, issue outcomes, and final resolutions in applicable systems.
- Identify recurring customer issues, handoff challenges, or documentation needs and share observations with internal stakeholders to support process improvement.
- Provide guidance and recommendations to customers on product features, best practices, and adoption strategies to maximize product usage and value.

**Skills & Competencies:**

- Proven experience in a customer-facing role, preferably as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar (2+ years preferred).
- Strong understanding of customer success principles, customer retention, and product adoption strategies.
- Ability to manage structured customer onboarding projects, track milestones, document next steps, and drive customers through implementation and go-live timelines.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels of an organization.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer accounts and priorities simultaneously. Self-motivation and organization are highly important.
- Solid problem-solving skills and the ability to address customer concerns with empathy and professionalism.
- Ability to recognize customer risk, summarize account trends, communicate next steps clearly, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve customer needs.
- Proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT).
- Previous experience with contract renewals, and expansion and adoption opportunities.
- Experience with SaaS (Software as a Service) products or technology services is highly desirable.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or related field, or equivalent experience.
- Experience in a B2B environment, particularly with high-value enterprise customers.
- Previous experience supporting customer onboarding, implementation, software launch, or customer training activities in a SaaS or technology environment preferred.
- Experience supporting customer escalations, retention risk tracking, account health conversations, renewals, cancellations, or account-change processes preferred.
- Previous experience working in the **tour operator/travel industry** in a customer success, support, trip planner, or sales/operations role is preferred.

Salary range: $60,000 - $70,000 USD.

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: AiBLE Strategic Sales Representative 3 -Lexington/ Louisville, KY
location: Lexington, Kentucky, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 29 Sep 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

# **A Day in the Life**

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.

Our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE™ connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes across the globe.

Check us out on LinkedIn: [Medtronic CST](https://www.linkedin.com/company/medtronic-brain-and-spine-therapies/posts/?feedView=all)

Explore our AiBLE product portfolio for spinal and cranial procedures [here](https://www.medtronic.com/en-us/healthcare-professionals/specialties/spinal-cranial-orthopedic/therapies-procedures/technology-ai-driven-surgery/aible-smart-ecosystem/product-portfolio.html) .

Within the Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit, the AiBLE Strategic Sales Representative partners closely with sales leadership, surgeons, hospital stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to drive adoption and execution of Medtronic AiBLE platforms and strategic initiatives across the region. This role serves as a key commercial and clinical liaison responsible for supporting complex technology integration, procedural optimization, and long-term account development strategies. This individual will lead strategic technology initiatives focused on robotic-assisted surgery, navigation, advanced imaging, digital workflows, implants, biologics and enabling technologies that support spine procedures.

This is a **field-based** role.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

- Promotes and sells Medtronic's Cranial & Spinal Technologies AiBLE products and services within an assigned geographic area and /or specific customer accounts to meet or exceed sales targets.
- Drive strategic adoption and utilization of Spine Enabling Technologies platforms, implants and biologics across targeted health systems and accounts
- Partner with Regional Sales Directors, District Sales Managers, Spine Sales Representatives, and cross-functional leadership to execute regional growth strategies
- Support successful launch, integration, and optimization of enabling technologies including navigation, robotics, imaging, and digital surgical platforms
- Develop and execute account-specific strategic technology plans aligned to business objectives and customer needs
- Serve as a subject matter expert on enabling technologies, procedural workflows, implants, biologics, procedural workflows, and technology integration.
- Build relationships with spine surgeons, administrators, OR leadership, procurement teams, and executive stakeholders
- Assist with technology evaluations, ROI justification, and value-based selling initiatives
- Coordinate and support surgeon education programs, cadaver labs, technology demonstrations, and customer training events
- Identify workflow efficiencies and procedural optimization opportunities that improve customer experience and patient outcomes
- Collaborate with marketing, training, operations, and clinical teams to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support
- Analyze regional performance metrics, utilization trends, and customer adoption data to drive strategic decision making
- Provide field intelligence and customer feedback to leadership and product development teams
- Travel extensively throughout assigned geography to support customer and business needs

# **Qualifications**

## **Must Have: Minimum Requirements**

*To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile.*

- High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 8+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences; or
- Associates Degree and 6+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences; or
- Bachelor's Degree and 4+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences.

## **Nice to Haves: Preferences**

- Experience supporting spine, neurosurgery, orthopedic, or robotic-assisted surgical procedures
- Strong understanding of Spine procedural workflows, operating room dynamics, and healthcare economics
- Operating room and sterile field experience strongly preferred
- Experience working directly with surgeons and hospital clinical teams
- Strong technical troubleshooting and customer-facing communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced field environment
- Experience with Biologics

**Additional Requirements:**

- Ability to travel extensively within assigned territory
- Ability to work in hospital and operating room environments
- Ability to stand for extended periods during surgical procedures
- Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 pounds
- Must possess a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy.

Note: Your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses. 

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at [AskHR@medtronic.com](mailto:AskHR@medtronic.com).

‌

# **Benefits & Compensation**

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create.  We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), which provides the opportunity to earn significant incentive compensation for achieving or exceeding your goals.

title: Implementation Specialist II
description:
**Job Description:**

Hawthorn River, a Computer Services Inc. (CSI) company, is looking for an experienced and customer-focused Implementation Specialist II to help financial institutions successfully adopt and launch Hawthorn River’s loan origination software. In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to customers throughout the full implementation lifecycle—from initial discovery and data gathering through system configuration, testing, training, go-live support, and post-launch stabilization.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys managing complex projects, building strong client relationships, solving business and technical challenges, and helping customers translate operational needs into effective software solutions. The Implementation Specialist II will lead and coordinate Loan Origination Software implementation projects while ensuring each engagement remains aligned with customer expectations, project timelines, and the broader goals of Hawthorn River and CSI.

**Responsibilities:**

- Lead implementation projects from kickoff through go-live, including planning, coordination, execution, and completion of key project milestones.
- Partner with financial institution customers to gather requirements, understand operational workflows, and confirm configuration needs for the loan origination platform.
- Define project scope, goals, deliverables, tasks, timelines, and required resources in collaboration with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
- Create and maintain project schedules, implementation timelines, task lists, and status updates to keep projects organized and on track.
- Coordinate and facilitate data gathering sessions, configuration discussions, testing reviews, training sessions, and go-live preparation meetings.
- Lead customer testing and review sessions, helping clients validate system functionality, identify issues, and prepare for successful adoption.
- Deliver customer training and provide hands-on support throughout implementation, go-live, and early post-launch activity.
- Manage communication across internal teams, customers, vendors, and other project stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and timely issue resolution.
- Monitor project progress, identify risks or blockers, escalate concerns when appropriate, and present clear updates on progress, issues, and resolutions.
- Stay current on product enhancements, new functionality, and loan origination best practices to better support customers and improve implementation outcomes.

**Requirements:**

- 3+ years of experience as a project manager, implementation specialist, client success professional, or similar role within the fintech, banking, financial services, or software implementation space.
- Experience with loan origination processes, lending workflows, or financial institution operations, including familiarity with the loan lifecycle from application through closing and funding.
- Experience implementing SaaS, banking technology, lending platforms, core-adjacent systems, or other customer-facing financial software solutions.
- Strong ability to manage multiple moving pieces, prioritize work, meet deadlines, and keep stakeholders informed throughout the project lifecycle.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain project expectations, system functionality, timelines, risks, and next steps to both internal teams and external customers.
- Comfortable leading remote meetings, customer presentations, training sessions, and collaborative working sessions with clients and vendors.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguity, troubleshoot issues, and help customers navigate change during implementation.
- A customer-first mindset with a professional, consultative approach to building trust and guiding clients toward successful outcomes.

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. title: Field Application Scientist - Flow Cytometry - 85% Travel
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today: time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.
  
  
We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.
  
  
It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The

**Job Title: Principal Product Manager (Cloud Media Solutions)**

**Summary:**

As the Principal Product Manager, Media Solutions, you will bring strategic leadership, strong business acumen, and deep technical expertise to the Cloud platform. You are a critical thinker who thrives in highly cross-functional environments and can balance long-term vision with execution.

In this role, you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of Cloud Media Solutions, with a strong focus on modern, cloud-native, API-first communications across web, desktop, and mobile-first experiences. You will play a key role in advancing next-generation voice platforms built on modern telephony architectures, with a particular emphasis on delivering high-quality, low-latency audio experiences that power AI-driven voice bots and virtual agents.

This position combines individual contribution with team leadership, partnering closely with business leaders, customers, and engineering teams. You will drive product definition, development, and go-to-market execution, ensuring solutions are scalable, developer-friendly, and capable of supporting real-time, intelligent voice interactions at global scale. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern VoIP architectures and SIP-based communications, along with hands-on experience in real-time media technologies such as RTP, WebRTC, and advanced audio processing. A strong API-first mindset and a track record of building platforms that enable programmable, high-fidelity voice experiences for AI applications is essential.

**Minimum Requirements:**

⦿ 8+ years of experience in cloud-based solutions, with a strong background in product management for communications and media platforms

⦿ 8+ years of experience driving go-to-market strategy with customers, partners, and developers

⦿ Deep expertise in modern telephony, VoIP architectures, and SIP-based communications

⦿ Proven experience delivering high-quality, real-time audio and media solutions, ideally supporting AI voice bots, virtual agents, or conversational platforms

⦿ Strong experience with API-first platforms, developer ecosystems, and programmable communications Experience delivering customer experience solutions (e.g., IVR, Contact Center, UCC, QM, CRM)

⦿ Familiarity with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, and Media Solutions platforms

⦿ Proven ability to prioritize effectively and deliver in fast-paced, complex environments

⦿ Demonstrated success leading high-performing, cross-functional teams

⦿ Strong ability to influence and guide cross-functional stakeholders

⦿ BA/BS required

**Desirable Skills:**

⦿ Experience with AI-driven voice technologies, including speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), conversational AI, and virtual agents

⦿ Deep understanding of audio quality metrics and optimization techniques (e.g., MOS scoring, latency reduction, jitter buffering, codec selection)

⦿ Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

⦿ Excellent verbal and written communication skills

⦿ Experience building or scaling developer platforms, SDKs, and API ecosystems

**Key Responsibilities:**

⦿ Define and execute the Cloud Media Solutions roadmap, with a focus on modern telephony, real-time media, and AI-driven voice use cases

⦿ Lead cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, sales, support, IT, finance, and legal teams

⦿ Translate evolving market needs—especially around AI voice, automation, and real-time communications—into scalable, API-driven product requirements

⦿ Develop and deliver sales enablement materials and training to support go-to-market success

⦿ Support commercial and contractual initiatives with partners and customers

⦿ Identify and drive new business models and revenue opportunities, particularly around programmable communications, APIs, and AI-powered voice services

**Technical Enablement:**

⦿ Lead the evolution of modern telephony platforms, ensuring best-in-class performance in VoIP, WebRTC, and real-time media delivery

⦿ Drive deep expertise in SIP signaling, SIP trunking, and carrier interoperability, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and global reach

⦿ Own the strategy for high-quality audio delivery, including low-latency media pipelines, jitter control, packet loss mitigation, codecs, and audio optimization critical for AI voice bots and virtual agents

⦿ Champion API-first platform design, enabling developers and partners to easily build, extend, and integrate voice and media capabilities

⦿ Advocate for and deliver mobile-first communication experiences, ensuring consistent, high-quality media across devices and networks

⦿ Establish instrumentation and analytics to capture detailed customer usage and media quality metrics (e.g., MOS, latency, jitter)

⦿ Leverage usage and performance insights to design and optimize usage-based billing and monetization models ⦿ Enable customer transparency through in-app and API-based access to usage, performance, and billing data

**Business Transformation:**

⦿ Define and promote modern consumption models, packaging, and pricing tiers for Cloud Media Solutions, including AI-driven voice services

⦿ Ensure seamless integration with contact center (CCaaS), unified communications, and broader enterprise ecosystems

⦿ Drive monetization strategies for APIs, developer platforms, and AI-powered media capabilities
