title: Director of Alliances
description:
DataHub is an AI & Data Context Platform adopted by over 3,000 enterprises, including Apple, CVS Health, Netflix, and Visa. Innovated jointly with a thriving open-source community of 13,000+ members, DataHub's metadata graph provides in-depth context of AI and data assets with best-in-class scalability and extensibility.

The company's enterprise SaaS offering, DataHub Cloud, delivers a fully managed solution with AI-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities. Organizations rely on DataHub solutions to accelerate time-to-value from their data investments, ensure AI system reliability, and implement unified governance, enabling AI & data to work together and bring order to data chaos.

## **About DataHub**

DataHub transforms enterprise data into trusted context, enabling intelligent decision-making by humans and AI agents. The company was founded by the creators of the popular DataHub open source product that has more than 16,000 contributors and is used by thousands of organizations. The company’s flagship product, DataHub Cloud, is the leading context management platform trusted by the Global 2000 to ensure that context is always relevant, reliable, and continuously refreshed across the entire data estate.

## **The Role**

DataHub | Reports to Chief Marketing Officer

Partnerships are a core lever in DataHub's growth. We're hiring a Director of Alliances to own our partnership strategy end to end: building the systems that let partners help us close deals faster, deliver complete solutions, and generate new pipeline.

You'll build and run three interlocking motions: co-selling with hyperscalers and technology partners, certifying systems integrators to implement DataHub, and co-marketing with partners to source net new opportunities. This is a builder role. You'll design the playbooks, negotiate the agreements, and run the day to day partner relationships that turn strategy into revenue.

## **What You'll Own**

Partner-Influenced (Co-Sell)

- Build and run a structured, repeatable co-sell playbook with hyperscalers and other strategic technology partners
- Register deals, introduce account executives to partner counterparts, and drive joint pursuit of opportunities
- Own hyperscaler alliance relationships, including specialization and co-sell scoring programs
- Grow the share of deals that are meaningfully influenced by a partner

Partner-Fulfilled (Certification)

- Stand up a certification program for systems integrators, covering technical enablement, implementation, and specialized delivery tracks (such as compliance or migration work)
- Build enablement content, technical training, and a tiered partner scoring model
- Manage relationships with a portfolio of SI and GSI partners
- Grow the number of certified partners who can independently deliver DataHub implementations

Partner-Sourced (Co-Marketing)

- Identify and prioritize target accounts using partner pipeline, look-alike data, and joint account mapping
- Plan and execute joint marketing programs, from webinars to executive events, tailored to technical, business, and economic buyer personas
- Build joint partner pages, co-branded content, and the tracking infrastructure needed to attribute partner-sourced pipeline
- Grow the volume of net new opportunities sourced through partners

Program and Relationship Management

- Own the partnership roadmap and planning cadence, coordinating across sales, marketing, and product
- Negotiate and manage partnership agreements
- Represent DataHub at partner and industry events, including partner participation in DataHub's own conference and field events
- Partner closely with the technical enablement and events functions to deliver a complete partner experience

## **What You'll Bring**

- 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel roles at an enterprise software or data infrastructure company
- Direct experience building or scaling co-sell programs with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
- Experience standing up SI/GSI partner programs, including certification and enablement
- A track record of turning partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue, not just signed agreements
- Comfort operating at both strategic and hands on levels: you can build a three year alliance strategy and also personally register a deal in APN
- Strong cross functional collaborator, able to align sales, marketing, and product around shared partner goals
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for partner negotiations and executive reporting

## **Nice to Have**

- Familiarity with the data catalog, data governance, or metadata management space
- Experience with compliance or regulatory frameworks relevant to regulated industries
- Existing relationships within the AWS, Google Cloud, or major SI partner ecosystems

## **Reporting and Location**

This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and works closely with sales leadership, product marketing, and the technical enablement team.

## **Benefits and Perks**

We invest in people so they can do their best work and enjoy doing it. Our benefits reflect the way we build: practical, thoughtful, and designed to support long-term growth.

**Competitive compensation**

We offer salaries that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you make. You bring value—we make sure you're recognized for it.

**Equity for everyone**

Every team member receives an ownership stake in the company. When we grow, you grow with us.

**Remote Work**

All roles are remote unless otherwise specified in the job description. Review the job description to confirm if the role you are interested in is remote or hybrid.

**Location flexibility**

Home office, coworking space, or something in between? We support your ideal setup. You’ll receive a monthly coworking stipend to use whenever you need a change of pace or in-person collaboration time.

**Comprehensive health coverage**

Your well-being matters. We cover 99% of medical, dental, and vision premiums employees, and 65% for dependents.

**Flexible savings accounts**

We offer FSAs to help cover planned or unexpected healthcare costs. You can also opt into a Dependent Care FSA to support family needs.

**Support for every path to parenthood**

Through Carrot Fertility, we provide inclusive fertility benefits and family-forming support. All U.S. employees have access, regardless of age, gender identity, or family structure.

**Time off that works for you**

We trust you to take the time you need. Our unlimited PTO and sick leave policy is designed for flexibility, rest, and real life.

  

## **Why Join Us**

DataHub is at a rare inflection point: we’ve achieved product-market fit, earned the trust of leading enterprises, and secured backing from top-tier investors like Bessemer Venture Partners and 8VC. The context platform market is expected to grow from $1B to $9B in the next five years—and we’re leading the way.

By joining our team, you’ll:

- Tackle high-impact challenges at the heart of enterprise AI infrastructure
- Ship production systems that power real-world use cases at global scale
- Collaborate with a high-caliber team of builders who’ve scaled some of the most influential data tools in the world
- Build the next generation of AI-native data systems, including conversational agents, intelligent classification, automated governance, and more

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy working with customers, and want to be part of a fast-growing company changing the industry, we want to hear from you!

title: Staff Solutions Engineer
description:
**Why Mozilla?**

**Mozilla Corporation** is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of **Firefox**, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the **501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation**, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

We’re now seeking a **Senior Solutions Engineer (DACH)** to support the growth of Firefox Enterprise across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. This is a highly customer-facing technical role focused on helping enterprises evaluate, validate, and deploy Firefox Enterprise in secure, complex, and regulated environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical credibility, strong enterprise architecture experience, and a passion for helping customers solve real-world security, deployment, and interoperability challenges.

**What you'll do:**

- Partner with Sales to support strategic enterprise opportunities across DACH.
- Lead technical discovery and solution design with customers and partners.
- Run workshops with customer stakeholders across security, infrastructure, IAM, endpoint management, and workplace technology.
- Own the relationship to the customer’s technical counterparts during and after the sales process.
- Help customers evaluate Firefox Enterprise in areas such as deployment, policy management, identity integration, logging, security controls, and operational fit.
- Design and support pilots, proofs of concept, and rollout plans.
- Advise customers on deployment models, architecture decisions, and integration approaches for enterprise environments.
- Validate interoperability across systems such as SSO, MFA, SIEM, proxy/network controls, endpoint tooling, certificates/PKI, and browser policy frameworks.
- Identify and help resolve technical risks early, including application compatibility, certificate handling, deployment complexity, and policy enforcement requirements.
- Create reusable technical assets such as reference architectures, deployment guidance, validation plans, and technical enablement materials.
- Support and enable partners involved in deployment, integration, and customer success.
- Champion Mozilla’s values of openness, trust, and user agency in every customer interaction.

**What you'll bring:**

- Significant experience (7+ years) in a senior Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Security Architect, or Technical Account Manager role.
- Ideally deep knowledge of the DACH IT landscape, particularly within the public sector, financial services, or KRITIS (Critical Infrastructure) operators .
- Strong background in enterprise security, endpoint management, browser security, Zero Trust, IAM, or digital workplace infrastructure.
- Hands-on knowledge of:
- - Windows enterprise deployment
  - GPO / MDM / policy management
  - certificates / PKI / TLS / proxies
  - SSO / MFA / IdP integrations
  - SIEM / DLP / CASB ecosystems
  - Kubernetes / Helm for customer-operated environments
- Experience supporting pilots, technical evaluations, or enterprise deployments in complex customer environments.
- Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into technical configurations and sales evidence.
- Ability to communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.
- Comfort working across ambiguity and helping customers move from evaluation to deployment with confidence.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Native-level fluency in German

**What you'll get:**

- A highly competitive base salary, plus a high-impact, performance-driven sales bonus plan.
- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
- One-time home office stipend
- Annual professional development budget
- Quarterly well-being stipend
- Considerable paid parental leave
- Employee referral bonus program
- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

**About Mozilla**

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. title: Staff Application Security Engineer (R5949)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

We are seeking a Staff Application Security Engineer to build and advance a scalable, developer-centered application security program. This role will establish company-wide secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) policy and standards, translate them into practical engineering practices, and partner directly with product, platform, and development teams to improve secure development and software supply-chain maturity.

The successful candidate combines technical application-security depth with the programmatic leadership to drive enterprise-wide improvement. You will help teams build, test, package, release, and maintain secure software while ensuring security controls are practical, measurable, and integrated into existing engineering workflows.

This is a Staff level individual-contributor role with significant influence across engineering, security, product, and technology leadership.

### **What you'll do:**

- Establish, maintain, and continuously improve company-wide secure SDLC policies, standards, control objectives, procedures, and supporting evidence requirements.
- Translate security policy into clear, achievable requirements for development, product, and platform teams without creating unnecessary delivery friction.
- Assess the maturity of development teams, CI/CD pipelines, source-control practices, build environments, and release processes; define and lead practical improvement roadmaps.
- Develop secure-development guidance, reference architectures, reusable patterns, security guardrails, exception processes, and developer enablement materials.
- Partner directly with development teams to identify, triage, prioritize, remediate, and verify application-security findings.

\* Evaluate, implement, tune, and operationalize application-security tooling, including:\* Static application security testing (SAST)  

- Dynamic application security testing (DAST)
- Software composition analysis (SCA)
- Secrets detection
- Infrastructure-as-code security scanning
- Container and image security scanning
- API and cloud-native application security controls

- Ensure security tooling produces actionable, appropriately prioritized findings and does not create unnecessary developer burden through excessive false positives.
- Lead or facilitate threat modeling, security requirements definition, and secure design or architecture reviews for high-risk applications, integrations, and material changes.
- Establish risk-based vulnerability management processes, including severity criteria, remediation service-level objectives, compensating controls, formal risk acceptance, escalation, and exception management.
- Develop and maintain processes for identifying, tracking, and remediating vulnerable third-party, open-source, and transitive dependencies.
- Establish open-source software governance, including component inventory, license identification, license review, approval workflows, and policy enforcement.

\* Mature software supply-chain security practices, including:\* Machine-readable software bills of materials (SBOMs)  

- Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) or equivalent vulnerability-status communications
- Build and release provenance
- Artifact, package, container-image, and binary signing
- Artifact verification and trusted promotion processes
- Secure artifact repositories and package registries
- Approved dependency sources and package integrity verification
- SLSA-aligned build integrity, provenance, and release controls

- Partner with DevOps and platform engineering to secure CI/CD pipelines, including least-privilege access, protected branches, secure secret handling, hardened build environments, and release approvals.
- Establish requirements for secure source-code repositories, build systems, dependency registries, artifact repositories, and deployment pipelines.
- Support application vulnerability intake, coordinated disclosure, customer-facing security advisories, CVE triage where applicable, and product-security incident response.
- Create and lead a security champions program that provides developers with secure-coding guidance, training, office hours, practical tools, and a pathway for timely security engagement.
- Develop executive-ready metrics and reporting on secure-SDLC adoption, AppSec risk, remediation performance, control coverage, software supply-chain integrity, and program maturity.
- Support customer, regulatory, audit, and assurance activities related to secure-development and software supply-chain practices.

NIST’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), documented in NIST SP 800-218, provides a practical foundation for secure-development practices across organizational preparation, software protection, secure production, and vulnerability response.

### **Required qualifications:**

- 7+ years of experience in application security, product security, DevSecOps, secure software engineering, cybersecurity engineering, or a closely related field.
- Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or maturing a secure SDLC or application-security program across multiple engineering teams.
- Strong working knowledge of secure coding practices, application-security testing, vulnerability management, software delivery, and DevSecOps principles.
- Experience working directly with developers to explain findings, guide remediation, and improve secure-development practices.
- Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency vulnerability management, secrets scanning, and related application-security tooling.
- Experience integrating security controls into source-control, CI/CD, build, release, and deployment workflows.
- Experience performing or facilitating threat modeling, security design review, architecture review, or security requirements definition.
- Knowledge of common application-security risks, including authentication, authorization, API security, insecure deserialization, injection vulnerabilities, insecure dependency use, secrets exposure, and business-logic vulnerabilities.
- Experience with software supply-chain security concepts, including SBOMs, dependency provenance, build integrity, artifact signing, release attestations, and secure artifact management.
- Experience with open-source software risk management, including vulnerable dependencies, transitive dependencies, license obligations, and governance processes.
- Familiarity with NIST SP 800-218 / SSDF, OWASP SAMM, SLSA, or comparable secure-development and supply-chain security frameworks.
- Ability to read and assess production code and scripts in one or more modern programming languages.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and tradeoffs to developers, leaders, auditors, and nontechnical stakeholders.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

- Experience implementing SLSA practices, signed software attestations, build provenance, hardened build systems, or release integrity controls.
- Experience with VEX, CSAF, SBOM formats such as SPDX or CycloneDX, and component or vulnerability intelligence workflows.
- Experience securing cloud-native applications, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, microservices, and infrastructure-as-code.
- Experience with common source-control, CI/CD, cloud, artifact-management, package-management, or container-registry platforms.
- Experience with tools such as Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, GitHub Advanced Security, GitLab security tools, Semgrep, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Mend, Black Duck, or comparable technologies.
- Experience with NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or other regulated-environment requirements.
- Experience supporting commercial software, government, defense, critical-infrastructure, or other high-assurance product environments.
- Relevant certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, GWAPT, GWEB, OSWE, GIAC, cloud-security certifications, or comparable credentials.

title: Service Desk Analyst II
description:

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

  

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please [click here](https://www.shrinerschildrens.org/en/locations?listPage=1) to learn more about our locations.

  

**CURRENT EMPLOYEES**: Please log into Workday [Click Here](https://identity.wd12.myworkday.com/wday/authgwy/shrinerschildrens/upc/login) to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"

  

**Job Description**

  

The Service Desk Analyst II serves as a senior member of the Information Services Service Desk and provides first-line technical support for software applications, hardware, and information systems utilized throughout the organization. This position acts as a backup to the Department Manager and assists with the daily operations of the Service Desk, including staffing coordination, scheduling, work assignments, quality monitoring, and team development.

  

The Service Desk Analyst II is responsible for responding to user inquiries, troubleshooting software and hardware issues, managing incident resolution, developing end-user documentation, and training materials, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. This role collaborates closely with Information Services teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve technical issues and improve service delivery. The position requires strong Service Desk experience, technical troubleshooting skills, leadership abilities, and knowledge of enterprise applications, preferably within a healthcare environment.

  

There are two openings for the Service Desk Analyst II position. The weekly schedule for each of these two openings is:

- 3PM - 12AM Midnight ET Monday through Friday
- 3PM - 12AM Midnight ET Saturday through Wednesday

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Serve as a senior resource for the Service Desk and provide backup support to the Department Manager.
- Assist the Supervisor with daily Service Desk operations, including staffing, scheduling, workload distribution, queue management, and support coverage.
- Monitor and resolve Service Desk incidents and service requests while ensuring compliance with service level expectations.
- Review and audit incidents and service requests for quality, accuracy, documentation standards, and customer service excellence.
- Mentor, coach, and train Service Desk personnel to strengthen technical knowledge, service delivery, and troubleshooting capabilities.
- Provide ongoing guidance to Service Desk staff regarding best practices, processes, and procedures.
- Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend enhancements to Service Desk operations and customer experience.
- Provide first-line support for all organizational software applications, including EPIC, Workday and other enterprise business and clinical systems.
- Receive, document, prioritize, assign, track, and resolve user-reported incidents and service requests.
- Troubleshoot and resolve PC-related hardware, software, operating system, peripheral, and connectivity issues.
- Install, configure, and maintain desktop and laptop software applications.
- Coordinate with Information Services personnel, vendors, and support teams to resolve escalated incidents and implement solutions.
- Ensure incidents are assigned to the appropriate support resources and actively tracked through final resolution.
- Install software upgrades, patches, revisions, fixes, and new application releases.
- Provide support for Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneDrive.
- Advise users on effective methods and best practices for utilizing software products and technology resources.
- Provide specialized support for enterprise and healthcare applications, including SHCIS, Epic, Cerner, PMTI, SBT, Workday, CARE, and other applications assigned.
- Investigate hardware issues and perform minor hardware repairs and communication connection troubleshooting.
- Develop and maintain end-user documentation for internally developed and vendor-supported applications.
- Create reference manuals, quick-reference guides, tutorials, knowledge base articles, FAQs, training materials, and online help resources.
- Ensure all documentation adheres to organizational standards and best practices.
- Plan, coordinate, develop, and conduct end-user training programs as needed.
- Deliver application-specific and productivity software training to support user adoption and organizational initiatives.
- Maintain and continuously improve knowledge management resources to support first-contact resolution and self-service capabilities.
- Assist in the evaluation, recommendation, and selection of hardware, software, communications technologies, consulting services, and system integration solutions.
- Participate in side-by-side product reviews, weighted assessments, cost-benefit analyses, and price-performance comparisons.

- Provide recommendations that align with organizational goals, operational needs, and technology strategies.

- Participate in software testing, validation, and quality assurance activities.
- Support rotating schedules and after-hours coverage requirements as needed.

**Required Qualifications:**

- Experience supporting enterprise business applications and end-user technologies.

- Experience with ticketing systems, and service request tracking tools.

title: Senior Market Development Manager- GI and Endo-surgical Innovation
industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

**Primary Function of Position**

The Senior Market Development Manager is a market-facing commercial leader for **new indications, customer bases, markets and platforms** — operating across the full spectrum from product development through early commercialization. This role builds early go-to-market strategy, validates product market fit, ensures the commercial perspective informs upstream decisions, and builds the market infrastructure required for successful future Intuitive launches.  **This individual will focus on GI and endosurgical innovation.**

This role is deeply integrated with **engineering, product, clinical, regulatory, market access and corporate strategy teams** in both existing business units and future forward— serving as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and embedding market insight into product, clinical evidence, and market access roadmaps. Success requires equal fluency and trust in the external market and the internal development cycle.

The Senior Market Development Manager works directly with **physicians, hospital executives, payers, and societies** to identify unmet needs and shape clinical and commercial strategy. Where markets must be created rather than captured, this role is tasked with designing strategies to shift **patient pathways, referral patterns, and clinical beliefs** to unlock demand and accelerate commercial success.

**Essential Job Duties** (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)

- Serve as market-facing commercial lead throughout the upstream development cycle; bring commercial guidance to inform strategy and optimize launch success
- Refine product market fit with market insight
- Generate deep market, customer, and clinical insights; translate into actionable product and commercial recommendations aligned with the largest unmet clinical needs
- Partner with engineering, product, clinical, and corporate strategy teams to define and execute go-to-market strategy from product development through early commercialization; serve as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and influence product roadmap and prioritization
- Identify and engage KOLs, society leadership, and key stakeholders to shape market entry, build pre-market advocacy, and market seeding priming early adoption
- Support clinical and economic evidence-building to enable market access, value articulation, and regulatory/ reimbursement strategy; support transfer into ROI and economic value models
- Understand existing commercial strategy and ways of working across Intuitive- find opportunities to leverage existing expertise to accelerate adoption in new domains.
- Develop market creation strategies where skillsets are not transferable— design approaches to change patient referral pathways, shift clinical beliefs and behaviors, and build demand in spaces where historic strategic success may be less transferable
- Originate and develop creative market entry strategies for new clinical spaces — write the playbook for indications where no established commercial model exists
- Synthesize complex inputs into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership
- Develop commercialization strategy for new indications, including salesforce structure, go-to-market model, pricing, territory design, and sales incentive plan frameworks

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- 10 years of experience in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Market Development in MedTech
- Prior leadership experience required, including direct or matrixed leadership

title: Enterprise Application Support Analyst
description:
We're looking for an
**Application Support Analyst**
who enjoys solving problems, helping users, and learning how business applications work behind the scenes.
  
  
This role will support a mix of day-to-day application issues, ticket management, user administration, documentation, and project work. Applied Epic experience is helpful, but it is not required for someone who has strong application-support experience, learns quickly, and is comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar systems.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

- Investigate and resolve functional and technical issues within enterprise business applications.
- Troubleshoot problems involving workflows, system access, user visibility, configuration, and application behavior.
- Work directly with users to understand issues, identify root causes, and determine the appropriate resolution.
- Validate system functionality after releases, configuration changes, integrations, or updates.
- Escalate more complex issues when they require deeper technical or cross-functional support.

**What We're Looking For**

- Application support experience — hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, or administering a business or enterprise application. Applied Epic is not required if the candidate has strong technical aptitude and can learn new systems quickly.
- Ticket queue management experience — experience personally managing incidents, service requests, or help desk tickets in ServiceNow or a comparable platform; understanding how to prioritize, manage SLAs, document resolutions, and balance multiple requests.
- Strong troubleshooting/problem-solving ability — able to investigate application issues, identify the cause, determine an appropriate solution, and know when escalation is necessary.
- Self-starter / learning agility — motivated, proactive, comfortable figuring things out, and able to learn unfamiliar applications without needing constant direction.
- User-facing communication skills — comfortable working directly with end users, explaining technical issues clearly, and maintaining a professional presence in a remote environment.
- Documentation discipline — able to create or update Knowledge Base articles, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and user support documentation when new issues or solutions arise.
- Ability to prioritize a high-volume workload and manage multiple requests at the same time.
- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while knowing when to ask for help or escalate an issue.
- Proactive, motivated, and willing to take initiative.

**Nice to Have**

- Hands-on Applied Epic support experience.
- ServiceNow experience.
- Application administration experience involving user setup, permissions, security/access, workgroups, or similar functions.
- Experience with minor application configuration or workflow changes.
- Experience supporting software upgrades, testing, releases, or system enhancements.
- Insurance / P&C industry experience.
- Comfortable using AI tools for productivity, problem-solving, documentation, communication, or process improvement.
- Mountain or Pacific time zone location is helpful for team coverage, but not required.

**Work Environment**

- Fully remote.
- 40/hour work week; Approximately 8:00 AM-5:00 PM based on local time zone, with some flexibility.
- U.S.-based team supporting users across the U.S. and Canada.
- Candidates in Mountain or Pacific time zones may be especially helpful for broader coverage.

**Client Solutions Specialist.**
The Client Solutions Specialist serves as a strategic support advisor, partnering with key clients to architect, optimize, and govern their platform integrations and Funnel product workflows. This role exercises independent judgment to align platform capabilities with client business objectives, drive adoption of existing and new product functionality, and mitigate enterprise-level operational risks. This role is designed for individuals who can work autonomously and can combine deep platform expertise with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and professionally to client stakeholders. This role does not simply escalate — it resolves, explains, and empowers. The salary range for this role is $75,000 - $90,000 per year.
  
  
**Why Funnel?**
We are a U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
  
  
**Who is Funnel Leasing?**
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We've created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We're in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you'll meet.
  
  
The
**Client Solutions Specialist's**
essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Your Opportunity**
At PLACE, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer. As a profitable, hypergrowth startup, on the path to an IPO, our standards are high, our team is scrappy, and our commitment is to execute the best work of our lives.
  
  
This is YOUR CHANCE to shape the backbone of a company that's scaling rapidly and innovating boldly. As our Technical Support Specialist, you'll partner with our Support Manager, founders, and executives to serve as the front-line technical point of contact for clients and end users across the Pyramid Platform, Red Bell infrastructure, and associated application suites — resolving issues, delivering training, and driving system improvements from insight all the way through to production. If you thrive in complexity, entrepreneurial problem-solving, and believe in scaling through tech and AI, this is your PLACE.
  
  
**Who Develops You:**
Support Manager
  
  
**What You're Great At**
You're a natural troubleshooter who genuinely enjoys helping people work through a problem, whether that's over the phone, over email, or side-by-side during a training session. You've got a foundation in real estate — maybe REO, rental management, loss mitigation, acquisitions, or short sales — and you're comfortable navigating Excel and Word without a second thought. You don't just close tickets; you notice patterns in them, and you're the kind of person who turns "this keeps happening" into a real recommendation for how to fix it. You manage your time well, know when to solve something yourself and when to loop in the right person, and you communicate clearly with clients, management, and developers alike. You're self-motivated, quick to pick up new systems, and comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

- Serve as the primary technical support contact for clients, outsourcers, agents, and other end users of the Pyramid Platform and Red Bell infrastructure
- Troubleshoot and resolve inbound technical issues and inquiries received via phone and email, meeting established SLA and quality standards
- Provide onboarding and ongoing training to new and existing users on platform functionality and best practices
- Proactively analyze support ticket trends to identify recurring issues and recommend system or process optimizations that reduce future ticket volume
- Propose new features and platform enhancements based on client feedback and observed usage patterns
- Communicate directly with clients and end users to gather and clarify requirements
- Collaborate with the development team to ensure business and client requirements are accurately understood and met
- Test new features and enhancements for quality and functionality prior to release to production
- Contribute to and maintain internal and client-facing knowledge base content
- Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word
- Real estate background required
- Experience in REO, Rental Management, Loss Mitigation, Real Estate Acquisition, or Short Sales strongly preferred
- Prior experience in a technical support, help desk, or client support role preferred
- Excellent organizational, time management, and prioritization skills
- Ability to effectively communicate with management, clients, and technical staff
- Self-motivated and willing to learn new systems and skills
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, while recognizing when to escalate
- Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
- Ability to analyze recurring issues and translate findings into actionable recommendations

**Salary:**
$21-27/hour depending on experience. This is a remote role but must be able to work from 8:00am to 5:00pm MST for core hours.
  
  
**Why PLACE**
We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and surrounded by others who are equally driven. That's why this role includes a "work from the PLACE you work best" approach – at home, in an office, or on the move. Our competitive benefits include PTO as needed, comprehensive insurance coverage, a 401(k) match, stock option grants, and a stock purchase plan. Every team member is an owner, building the "PLACE" they are proud to call "my company."

title: Finance Data Analyst - AI Enablement
description:
**Finance Data Analyst**

***Automation & AI Enablement | SAP Environment***

**About the Role**

We're looking for an energetic, technically curious Finance Data Analyst to join our finance team and help transform how we manage financial data. This role sits at the intersection of finance, automation, and emerging technology you'll work hands-on with financial data to design and build automated journal entry processes, and leverage AI and modern tools to streamline data flow across our finance environment. You'll be a key contributor to our digital finance transformation, working extensively within our SAP ecosystem.

This is an ideal role for someone who loves solving problems at the intersection of finance and technology, gets excited about automation, and wants to help modernize traditional finance processes.

**What You'll Do**

- Analyze and interpret financial data from multiple sources to identify patterns, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities
- Design, build, and maintain automated journal entry processes, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy
- Leverage AI tools and technologies (e.g., machine learning models, intelligent automation, generative AI) to streamline recurring finance workflows
- Develop and optimize data pipelines to improve the flow of financial data between systems
- Work extensively within SAP to extract, transform, and validate financial data, and to implement automated solutions
- Partner with Accounting, FP&A, and IT teams to understand pain points and translate them into automation and reporting solutions
- Build dashboards, reports, and reconciliation tools to support month-end close and financial reporting
- Test, validate, and monitor automated processes to ensure data integrity and compliance with financial controls
- Document processes, workflows, and automation logic for audit and knowledge-sharing purposes
- Stay current on emerging AI and automation tools relevant to finance operations and proactively recommend improvements

**What We're Looking For**

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
- Experience working with financial data (journal entries, ledgers, reconciliations, close processes, etc.)
- Hands-on experience with SAP (SAP FI/CO, SAP S/4HANA, or similar modules) is a plus
- Familiarity with AI/ML tools and interest in applying them to finance use cases (e.g., anomaly detection, predictive analytics, generative AI for reporting)
- Strong SQL and data manipulation skills is a plus; Excel power-user capabilities
- Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) a plus
- Understanding of accounting principles and journal entry / GL processes
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong communication skills able to explain technical solutions to non-technical finance stakeholders

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

- Energetic and self-driven you take initiative and enjoy finding better ways to do things
- Naturally curious about new technology, especially AI, and excited to apply it in a business context
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
- A collaborative mindset you enjoy working cross-functionally with finance, accounting, and IT teams
- Thrives on building things from scratch and continuously improving existing processes

**Nice to Have**

- Prior experience in a shared services, controllership, or finance transformation function
- Exposure to SAP automation tools (e.g., SAP Intelligent RPA, SAP Build) just a plus
- Certifications in RPA platforms, data analytics, or AI/ML fundamentals

**Why Join Us**

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of finance operations by combining financial expertise with cutting-edge automation and AI technology. You'll have the autonomy to identify problems, propose solutions, and see your automation work directly reduce manual effort across the finance organization.

title: Senior Software Engineer II (AI Enablement)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II (AI Enablement) based in United States.**
The Senior Software Engineer II will build and operate the platform infrastructure that enables organization-wide adoption of AI and agentic technologies. You will own critical systems spanning MCP gateway infrastructure, plugin distribution, model routing, observability, and AI platform tooling. The role combines deep platform engineering with direct business impact, including measurable effects on AI adoption, inference performance, and technology spend. You will work across backend services, developer platforms, security, infrastructure, and AI tooling in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will support both engineers and non-engineers by making agentic capabilities easier, safer, and more scalable to use. This is a hands-on platform role for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems with real users, operational ownership, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

- Own and extend the MCP Gateway and connector platform, building and hardening integrations with enterprise systems such as Glean, Slack, Jira, Snowflake, Salesforce, Monday, Tableau, and Databricks.
- Design and maintain authentication, authorization scopes, tenancy, rate limiting, and read/write policy enforcement for connected tools, partnering with Security and platform owners to establish safe-by-default access patterns.
- Own the plugin distribution layer and marketplace publishing pipeline, including versioning, CI/CD, plugin pull request reviews, release hygiene, and developer tooling synchronization.
- Build and maintain shared plugins, skills, hooks, and Spec-Driven Development tooling used across engineering teams.
- Create and maintain authoring documentation and guides that enable other teams to contribute to the platform independently.
- Own platform observability, model gateway configuration, and AI cost attribution, extending telemetry and usage pipelines to measure adoption, tool-call health, and inference spending by team, workload, and model.
- Define model-routing strategies and develop benchmarks and evaluation harnesses that support evidence-based decisions about model selection and performance.
- Extend infrastructure that transforms agent outputs into browsable, searchable, and collaborative experiences, including discovery, tagging, engagement instrumentation, comments, expiration, and sharing notifications.
- Run technical enablement activities such as office hours and educational sessions focused on agentic coding and plugin-authorship practices.
- Mentor engineers on AI platform development patterns, plugin creation, and effective use of agentic coding tools.
- Triage and consolidate incoming platform feature requests and help prioritize improvements based on user needs and platform impact.
- Participate in on-call responsibilities for marketplace-published artifacts and gateway availability.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Demonstrated production ownership of a backend service or developer platform, such as an API gateway, service proxy, SDK/CLI, internal developer platform, or comparable system, including responsibility for authentication, releases, and operational health.
- Strong production experience with at least one modern application stack such as Python, TypeScript/Node, Go, or a comparable technology.
- Strong experience with modern CI/CD practices and production software delivery.
- Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization for machine-to-machine traffic, including OAuth2, OIDC, M2M credentials, token scoping, and secret management.
- Demonstrated ability to instrument owned systems using metrics, structured logging, tracing, usage analytics, or similar observability practices and use resulting data to inform technical decisions.
- Direct hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Cody, Copilot agents, Aider, or equivalent tools in production or near-production environments.
- Strong written communication skills, including the ability to create technical documentation, runbooks, and educational resources for engineering teams.
- Experience authoring or maintaining MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, skills, hooks, or comparable LLM-tooling integrations is preferred.
- Experience operating an LLM gateway or inference proxy in production, including routing, fallback, caching, quotas, and cost attribution, is preferred.
- Experience building evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for LLM systems, including A/B comparisons of prompts, tools, or model versions, is a plus.
- Experience operating a package registry, plugin ecosystem, or extension marketplace, including publishing pipelines, semantic versioning, compatibility management, and deprecation processes, is beneficial.
- Background in healthcare technology, HIPAA-regulated environments, or systems handling protected health information is preferred.
- Familiarity with business associate agreements and data-residency considerations for third-party tooling is a plus.
- Experience with technologies such as Python/FastAPI, Vue/TypeScript, Postgres, AWS, Auth0, Datadog, or Sumo Logic is beneficial but not required.
- Comfort working across frontend, backend, and infrastructure boundaries.
- Experience as an early engineer on an internal platform where adoption must be earned through product quality and user value is a plus.
- Strong collaboration, mentoring, problem-solving, ownership, and cross-functional communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and manage prolonged periods of computer-based work.

**Benefits**

- Remote work arrangement within the United States.
- Full-time position with a senior-level platform engineering scope.
- Opportunity to work on AI enablement infrastructure supporting organization-wide adoption of agentic technologies.
- Direct ownership of systems with measurable impact on AI usage, inference costs, model performance, and developer productivity.

title: VP, Operations and AI Enablement
description:
**Vice President, Business Operations & AI Enablement**

*Reports to: Chief Executive Officer | Location: Houston, TX (preferred)*

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Vice President of Business Operations & AI Enablement, a builder who turns business problems into working AI-enabled systems in weeks rather than quarters. This is a hands-on role with a wide, cross-functional remit. You will take a problem from any part of the business, whether commercial and business development, property accounting, human resources, transitions, or corporate operations, prototype the solution with modern AI tooling, prove it against real company data, and hand it off to the function that will own it. This role partners closely with the Chief Transformation Officer and technology leadership, who own the company's AI strategy, technology organization, and data platform, and works alongside the Chief of Staff as a peer. Success is measured concretely: working systems in production, used daily, with a credible line to capacity released or revenue created.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Identify, scope, and personally build AI-enabled workflows and internal tools that remove manual effort from the business, working in modern AI development environments rather than a traditional development queue.
- Move from problem statement to working prototype in days or weeks, tested against real company data, iterating directly with the users who will live with the result.
- Partner with the technology organization to harden, integrate, secure, and support anything that graduates from prototype to production.
- Instrument every build with a baseline, a measure, and an honest read on whether it is actually being used.
- Document how work actually gets done across functions in scope, and identify where handoffs, rework, and manual reconciliation consume capacity.
- Distinguish problems that automation solves from problems that require a process, training, or organizational fix.
- Translate between operators who know the business and technologists who know the systems.
- Close the gap between AI tools deployed and AI tools actually used, driving genuine daily adoption among analysts, accountants, and business development staff.
- Build and run practical enablement - office hours, working sessions, internal prompt libraries, and worked examples drawn from the company's own processes.
- Develop internal power users in each function who can build for themselves, rather than centralizing all demand in this role.
- Maintain a live, honestly ranked view of automation opportunities across the business, sized by effort, data readiness, and value, and bring that view to the CEO and leadership team on a standing basis.

**REQUIREMENTS**

- 8-15 years running or improving operations in a complex, multi-site, people-heavy business; has owned a process, a P&L line, or a function.
- Has personally built working things with modern AI tooling (agents, internal applications, data pipelines, automations) and can speak credibly about what they built, what broke, and what they'd do differently. Strategy decks, vendor selection, or pilot governance alone are not a fit.
- Comfortable turning an idea into something real over a weekend and presenting it to a skeptical operator on Monday; works well in ambiguity, without a team beneath them, and without an established process.
- Able to decompose a messy operational problem, get to the data, and reach a defensible answer - equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a database, or a conversation with a frontline operator about why a process broke down.
- Able to sit with a regional manager, an accountant, and a data engineer in the same afternoon and be taken seriously by all three.
- Knows when to stop: ships the version that solves 80% of the problem, resists building a platform when a workflow will do, and hands off cleanly rather than accumulating tools only they can maintain.
- Comfortable operating with a wide remit and deliberately little formal authority; influence comes from credibility and shipped work, not the org chart.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

- **Experience:**
  8-15 years in operations leadership within a complex, multi-site, people-heavy business, with a track record of owning a process, a P&L line, or a function end to end.
- **Core Fluency:**
  Equal command of how operating businesses actually behave (process ownership, P&L, field operations) and hands-on AI build capability (agents, internal applications, data pipelines, automations) - an operator who builds, not an engineer who has been given an operations title.
- **Communication:**
  Exceptional ability to translate between operators, technologists, and executives; builds credibility quickly and without formal authority, and teaches as a matter of habit.
- **Education:**
  No specific degree required. Formal software engineering training is welcome but not required. Demonstrated building experience and an operating track record matter more than formal credentials.

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Direct experience in real estate, property management, or multi-site services.
- Experience in a private-equity-backed environment.
- PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management background.
- Prior experience building internal AI enablement programs (office hours, prompt libraries, internal training).
- A track record of shipping something inside a company that didn't ask for it - and being thanked for it afterward.

title: Corporate Consultant - Senior Editorial Writer & Content Strategist
description:
# **We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.**

# **Senior Editorial Writer**

# **ModSquad | Marketing | Contractor/Freelancer**

  
  
  

## ***About the Role***

ModSquad is executing a brand-led marketing strategy. We're looking for a contract editorial writer who covers our category the way a trade journalist or industry analyst would – someone who already knows the outsourced customer support trust & safety landscape, and follows what the vendors and platforms are actually doing.

This is not a content marketing role. We're looking for someone who can interview our executives, read the industry data critically, surface the stories buried inside our client work, and shape all of it into pieces that people running digital operations actually want to read – published under our leaders' names and placed with the publications their peers already read.

If you've covered this beat at a trade publication, worked as an industry analyst, built original research that others cited, or ghostwritten executive bylines that didn't sound like press releases, we should talk.

  

## ***What You'll Do***

## **Editorial & Executive Voice**

- Ghostwrite executive articles for owned, social, and external distribution channels
- Interview internal SMEs, clients, and partners to extract story angles and original perspectives
- Develop sponsored editorial and co-authored pieces for targeted trade publishers
- Support live programming – office hours, panel appearances, recurring conversations with senior ModSquad voices – including prep, framing, and turning recordings into written pieces

## **Research & Category Analysis**

- Track the CX, trust & safety, moderation, and outsourcing landscape – competitor positioning, vendor claims, analyst coverage, regulatory movement – and tell us where our point of view has room to land
- Build data-led editorial: original surveys, benchmark analyses, state-of-the-industry pieces, and commentary grounded in real numbers
- Read industry research critically and translate it into an argument a practitioner can use
Identify the stories our competitors are not telling  

  

**Client Storytelling**

- Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify client stories worth telling
- Develop anonymized or attributed client stories that are specific and authentic, not templated
Build a repeatable process for sourcing, quantifying, and clearing client stories – including getting to business outcomes, not just a list of services delivered  

  

## ***What We're Looking For***

  

**Experience**

- Demonstrated experience covering or analyzing at least one of: customer experience, contact centers, BPO/outsourcing, trust & safety, content moderation, enterprise SaaS, or digital operations
- A track record in journalism, trade publishing, industry analysis, or research writing – not general content marketing
- Demonstrable executive ghostwriting, with published examples
Experience producing or interpreting original research – surveys, benchmark data, industry datasets  

  

**Skills**

- You can pull a story out of a 30-minute conversation with a busy executive
- You can take a pile of ideas or a rough brief and build a coherent, logical argument
- You know how trade publications work: pitching editorial angles, sponsored content, co-authorship, and when each is the right call
- You can name the publications, newsletters, and analysts that matter in this category
- Comfortable in plain text workflows, Markdown, and GitHub
- You know how to diagram a sentence, apply the Paramedic Method from Revising Prose, or have read Several Short Sentences About Writing more than once and have thoughts about how to apply it editorially
- You're allergic to AI slop
You're already thinking about how to improve this job description  

  

**Mindset**

- Operates with editorial judgment, not just execution; pushes back when a brief doesn't have a story yet
- Fast and self-directed; sets their own production pace without heavy oversight
Comfortable working as an independent contractor alongside an in-house team  

  

## **Compensation & Structure**

- This engagement is structured as an independent contractor arrangement and does not include employee benefits.
- The initial engagement will run for six months, with the possibility of extension based on business needs and project volume.
- The engagement is fully remote. Some availability during Pacific business hours may be needed for executive interviews and live programming; otherwise, the contractor may perform the services asynchronously.
- The contractor will work with the Content & Creative Production team and collaborate with the Head of Brand and VP of Marketing.
- Services will be requested on an as-needed basis, and weekly hours may vary depending on project volume.
- Compensation will be paid hourly. The contractor will track time through Teambridge Systems and submit monthly invoices for services performed.
All work product created under the engagement will be subject to the intellectual property and work-product provisions of the contractor agreement.  

**Location Restrictions**

U.S. Candidates: This engagement is not available to individuals who will perform services from New York City, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey. Contractors must perform services from an eligible U.S. location outside those jurisdictions for the duration of the engagement.

  

***How To Apply***

**Send us:**

- **Two writing samples that were published under someone else's name – an executive byline, a ghostwritten article, a placed piece. Tell us the outlet and roughly when. If the work is confidential, an anonymized version or a description of the engagement is fine; we understand ghostwriting is often unattributable.**
- **One sample under your own byline – ideally something reported, analytical, or data-driven**
- **A cover letter. We strongly encourage one. You're a writer, right? Write.**

***On AI: The cover letter and samples should be yours and we will be reading for that.***
