title: Technical Curriculum Developer - AI Agents - Remote
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
This is not a traditional curriculum developer role - please do not apply if you have dabbled with AI agents. In this unique role, we are accepting applications for two different personas:
  
  

- The AI Solutions Engineer turned Mentor/Coach - you have an engineering/development background and have become the AI/Technical Trainer to teach learners how AI agents to build and configure agents and AI best practices.
- The Technical Curriculum Developer turned AI Builder - you have a passion for teaching others deep technical topics, and have the curiosity and drive to learn and vibe code agentic solutions/integrations.

If you are one of these profiles and have proven, demonstrable experience - please apply now!
  
  
You'll build the training that teaches customers, partners and Veevans how to use, configure, and implement and integrate our platform — including its Agentic AI capabilities — and you'll build the AI agents that power our demos and hands-on labs.
  
  
You should be able to walk into an unfamiliar product area, understand its architecture and APIs, and within days be building working agent demos and lab exercises around it.
  
  
You'll also own and evolve our most technical training courses, the coding-intensive classes that require real Java and REST API fluency, bringing rigor and firsthand credibility that generalist curriculum developers can't.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**AI Agent Curriculum & Enablement**

- Design and build hands-on training and lab environments that teach technical learners how to build, configure, and deploy custom AI agents on our platform
- Build working AI agent demos and reference implementations from scratch to anchor training content and live demonstrations
- Translate the practical challenges learners face when configuring or implementing Agentic AI — tool/function calling, context management, prompt design, error handling, guardrails, orchestration — into clear, sequenced learning experiences
- Stay current with the agentic AI landscape (frameworks, MCP-style tool integrations, agent orchestration patterns)

**Technical Curriculum Development**

- Own and maintain our advanced technical courses, including classes that require coding in Java and working with REST APIs
- Build and maintain hands-on lab environments, sample code, sandbox data, and technical exercises that mirror real implementation scenarios
- Partner with Product and Engineering to get early access to new features and build courseware alongside General release
- Apply instructional design best practices (learning objectives, scaffolding, assessment design, adult learning principles) to technical content without watering down technical accuracy

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to understand agent architecture, APIs, and configuration options as they're being built
- Partner with Professional Services, Managed Services and Customer Support to identify pain points and close those gaps with curriculum

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Instructional Design, or equivalent practical experience
- Hands-on experience building, configuring, and deploying AI agents (e.g., using frameworks/SDKs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK/Claude Code, or similar)
- Practical understanding of core agent concepts: tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context/memory management, multi-agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and evaluation
- Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards is a strong plus
- First-hand experience troubleshooting the real problems agent builders hit — flaky tool calls, context overflow, hallucinated actions, permission/scoping issues — so you can teach learners to anticipate and solve them, not just follow a script
- Ability to read and understand Java code architecture and classes for minor development or debugging, alongside a strong foundational knowledge of REST APIs
- Experience with Git, Postman, or similar API tooling
- 3+ years building technical training, curriculum, or enablement content for a technical audience (developers, implementation consultants, technical admins, or power users)
- Experience designing hands-on labs, sandbox exercises, and high quality instructor-led courses and/or eLearning
- Familiarity with LMS platforms and AI/authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Camtasia, Arcade, Vyond, Gemini, Claude or similar) is a plus
- Experience with Veeva Vault, or ability to quickly ramp up on, complex enterprise SaaS platforms — including how Veeva Vault is configured and implemented by customers
- Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — this role will often be defining the curriculum for capabilities that are still being built
- Strong writing and technical communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to varied audiences (technical and semi-technical learners)
- Strong presentation and facilitation skills; comfortable leading live demos and workshops

**Interviewing with Veeva**
We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  
  

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

- A conversation with the hiring manager
- A practical case exercise
- A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

**Perks & Benefits**

- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
- Retirement programs
- 1% charitable giving program

**Compensation**

- Base pay: $100,000 - $175,000
- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent\_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Music Curriculum Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Location: 100% remote (within or outside the U.S.)
  
  
Classification: Full-time (30-40 hours/week)
  
  
Pay Range: $25.12 - $34.50
  
  
Welcome to Miaplaza!
  
  
Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy , Always Icecream , and Clever Dragons , and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep , MiaPrep Online High School (MOHS), and MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio , (MOAO). Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀
  
  
You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future !
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact (position Summary)**
Curriculum Developers work closely with other subject-matter experts, our production team, and an instructional coach to produce immersive, engaging, and academically rigorous learning materials that constitute the core of our curriculum. These materials include videos, assessments, and written learning activities. Curriculum Developers are experts in their fields who thrive on independent writing and design tasks with a feedback-oriented mindset. Our team relies on highly motivated, collaborative, and student-driven individuals.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (responsibilities)**

- Spend a majority of your time designing and developing music educational content (video scripts, assessments, and written materials) for grades 6-12 students
- Ensure content is pedagogically sound, engaging, age-appropriate, and accessible for students
- Write clear and measurable lesson objectives, and align teaching materials to meet objectives
- Use technology, such as Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs
- Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse student populations and needs
- Continuously evaluate and refine content based on feedback and educational outcomes
- Collaborate with peers on curriculum development
- Give and receive feedback on lessons, course development, and processes

Check out a day in the life of a Miaplaza Curriculum Developer !
  
  
**Job Requirements**
You may be a good fit if you have (requirements):
  
  

- A minimum of 2 years of full-time music classroom teaching experience at the 6-12 grade level
- A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Education or in a music-related field
- Familiarity with writing lesson objectives and creating objective-aligned lesson materials
- Experience creating well-structured and effective lessons
- Ability to differentiate instruction to make learning accessible, engaging, and age-appropriate
- Strong understanding of what makes a lesson engaging
- Experience using technology to support instruction, including Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, especially written
- Growth mindset and motivated by constructive feedback
- Proven ability to work independently, manage schedules, and meet deadlines
- High motivation, a proactive attitude, and a tendency to seek opportunities for continuous improvement
- High standards of integrity and transparency
- Access to a computer/laptop (with a camera) and a reliable high-speed internet connection

**What Makes You Stand Out (nice-to-haves)**

- You have an active teaching certification, and/or you have completed professional development or training in curriculum design and pedagogy
- You have hands-on experience designing and writing curriculum, including writing scripts for completely asynchronous video lessons
- You have experience teaching and designing lessons for AP Music Theory or Ear Training/Aural Skills
- You are comfortable with basic music technology, such as DAWs and music notation software
- You have experience analyzing and transforming data into actionable goals that have positively impacted your students
- You have experience with online instruction
- Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and a set of skills that may not be listed here but are still transferable to this role.
- If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply.

**Compensation & Benefits**

- This is an hourly position that requires a minimum of 30 hours a week for full-time status. The expected starting pay range is $25.12 - $34.50 per hour. When working 40 hours per week year-round, this equates to an approximate annual pay range of $52,249–$71,760.
- Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.
- Compensation is evaluated twice per year. Employee compensation is determined by lesson quality, efficiency, and performance.
- Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, including specialty care options such as fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, as well as FSA, HSA, and more.
- All employees are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match.
- PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour for every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 139 hours per year, or about 17 eight-hour days on average.
- Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.
- We invite your family and friends to join our journey! All employees receive free site memberships and discounted MOHS tuition for the children in their household, plus two additional memberships for other children in their lives.

**What You’ll Love About Working At Miaplaza**

- You’ll be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to innovative education solutions for children who learn in diverse ways.
- Our 100% remote team can work from any productive location within or outside the U.S. (no travel required!)
- We promote flexibility and encourage employees to shape their work environments and schedules around their lives!
- You’ll collaborate with colleagues on challenging and rewarding projects, and connect through community and culture events.
- Learn more by visiting our careers page !

**Schedule**

- Curriculum Developers are expected to have 30-40 hours of availability each week on a year-round basis. This range of hours is designed to offer flexibility in your schedule, and there is ample work available! We consider anything over 30 hours a week to be full-time, so you would be eligible for all of our benefits!
- We expect you to have the availability to communicate promptly and effectively with your team. You will have regular meetings with your supervisor and peers. You will also have required team meetings, like professional developments and department meetings. Beyond that, what your schedule looks like is up to you! Morning person? Night owl? Somewhere in between? As long as you are meeting your deadlines, actively communicating, and are available for weekly meetings, we support the hours that work best for you. THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 1ST, 2026.

Ready to apply?
  
  
Please start by submitting your application and resume. The hiring process is fully remote and includes assessments, an introductory interview, an assignment, and a final interview along with reference checks. Reflecting our commitment to our students, we prioritize accessibility and inclusivity in our hiring practices and across our team. Please contact HR if you need an accommodation at any point during the hiring or employment process. Miaplaza is an E-Verify participating employer for individuals hired in the United States. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  
  
**Links**

- Miacademy: https://parents.miacademy.co/
- Always Icecream: https://parents.always-icecream.com/
- Clever Dragons: https://parents.clever-dragons.com/
- MiaPrep: https://parents.miaprep.com/
- MiaPrep Online High School: https://miaprep.com/online-school/
- MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio: https://miapreponlineacademy.com/ohio/
- Hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company: https://tinyurl.com/miaplaza-CEO-video/
- Day in the life of Curriculum Developer Tik Tok: https://tinyurl.com/Mia-CD-2024
- Careers page: https://careers.miaplaza.com/

title: Training Developer
description:
**Edgewater Technical Associates** is seeking qualified candidates for a **Training Developer** opportunity.

**Work Location:** Remote

**Assignment Duration:** October 2026 to March 2027

**Job Description:**

The Training Developer is responsible for analyzing training needs, designing instructional solutions, developing learning content, and supporting workforce development initiatives across the organization. This position partners with operations, maintenance, safety, quality, engineering, and leadership teams to create effective training programs that improve employee performance, support compliance requirements, and enhance operational excellence. The Training Developer applies instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to develop classroom, e-learning, blended learning, and hands-on training solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Analyze organizational, operational, and technical training needs through collaboration with stakeholders and subject matter experts.
- Design, develop, and maintain training curricula, learning paths, instructional materials, participant guides, assessments, and job aids.
- Create engaging instructor-led, virtual, and e-learning training programs using adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
- Develop technical, operational, safety, compliance, and skills-based training content.
- Conduct job task analyses and competency assessments to identify training requirements and performance gaps.
- Collaborate with subject matter experts to capture and translate technical information into effective learning solutions.
- Design and implement employee onboarding, qualification, certification, and workforce development programs.
- Develop evaluation tools and metrics to measure training effectiveness and learner performance.
- Maintain and update training documentation, records, and learning management system (LMS) content.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance training processes and learning outcomes.
- Ensure training materials comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
- Support audits, inspections, and compliance initiatives related to workforce training programs.
- Facilitate training sessions and workshops as needed to support organizational requirements.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Education, Human Resources, Business, Industrial Technology, Technical Training, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
- Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting the development of training programs, instructional materials, or workforce development initiatives.
- Experience supporting industrial, manufacturing, production, processing, logistics, energy, chemical, automotive, aerospace, food manufacturing, or other technical operations environments.
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations, workplace safety programs, and compliance training requirements.
- Experience applying instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar frameworks.
- Strong technical writing, curriculum development, and content creation skills.
- Experience creating training assessments, evaluations, and competency-based learning materials.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and learning management systems.
- Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

**Preferred Experience:**

- 10+ years of relevant experience.
- Experience developing technical training for operators, technicians, maintenance personnel, skilled trades employees, or frontline production teams.
- Experience with e-learning development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or similar platforms.
- Familiarity with competency-based training, qualification programs, and workforce certification processes.

title: Curriculum Designer
description:
QuizCademy helps students get good at the hard subjects — coding, math, and science — through adaptive practice, homework help, and 1-on-1 coaching. We're looking for a Curriculum Designer to build the practice content at the heart of the product: standards-aligned topics, question blocks, and worked explanations that meet students where they are and move them to mastery. - Sequence practice so difficulty adapts and skills build, not cram
- Review and edit AI-assisted drafts for accuracy, clarity, and pedagogical quality
- Partner with coaches and engineering to keep content consistent and student-friendly
- Iterate on content using student performance and feedback signals

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

- Teaching, tutoring, or curriculum-design experience in at least one of: math, science, or computer science
- Deep command of the subject and its core standards for K-12 / early college
- Strong, plain-language writing and a knack for explaining hard ideas simply

- Bonus: credential or degree in education or the subject; experience with standards alignment; familiarity with edtech content tools
- Must pass our standard onboarding checks; work authorization required

title: Live Lesson Attendance Coordinator - Maine Connections Academy
description:
**Apply Here**

**School Summary**
At Connections Academy, helping students maximize their potential and meet the highest performance standards through a uniquely individualized learning program is at the core of our mission. Connections Academy was founded in 2001 to deliver high-quality, highly accountable online education to students in grades K-12. Hallmarks of Connections Academy-supported online schools include personalized learning, an award-winning curriculum and Education Management System (EMS), dedicated state-certified teachers, and a supportive school community. Parents of enrolled students consistently share their satisfaction with Connections Academy: 92% “would recommend the schools to other families” and 95% say the curriculum is “high quality.” Connections Academy-supported public schools serve students across the country, while Connections Academy is committed to expanding quality education through technology and helping students achieve both academic and personal success.
  
  
Maine Connections Academy (MCA) is a tuition-free, virtual public charter school for students in grades 7–12 statewide. MCA is authorized by the Maine Charter School Commission and is governed by an independent Board of Directors.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
**LiveLesson Attendance Coordinator**
is a
**1-year, full-time, 10-month position, grant-funded,**
focused on increasing student attendance and engagement in LiveLesson instructional sessions. The coordinator will work with students, families, teachers, counselors, and school leaders to identify students who are not consistently attending LiveLessons, determine and address barriers to participation, and provide targeted interventions and ongoing support to improve attendance.
  
  
**As a Term of Project position, employment will continue through the duration of the specific term which ends June 21, 2027.**
Particular attention will be given to students who have the greatest academic need for synchronous instructional support, including students who are failing or at risk of failing courses, students demonstrating patterns of disengagement, and students identified by teachers or school teams as needing additional intervention.
  
  
The LiveLesson Attendance Coordinator will use attendance and academic data to identify trends and prioritize outreach; meet directly with students and families to understand barriers; develop individualized attendance plans and interventions; monitor student progress; and provide persistent follow-up and encouragement. The coordinator will also partner with teachers to support attendance efforts for individual students, specific courses, grade levels, and LiveLessons experiencing attendance concerns.
  
  
This position serves as a key connection between students, families, teachers, and school leadership and will help ensure that students who most need direct instructional support are consistently connected to their teachers and learning opportunities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Monitor LiveLesson attendance and academic data to identify students with low or declining attendance, prioritizing students who are failing, at risk of failing, or otherwise in need of additional instructional support.
- Conduct proactive outreach and meet with students and families to identify barriers to LiveLesson attendance and develop individualized strategies to address them.
- Provide targeted attendance interventions, including reminders, goal setting, problem-solving, accountability, and ongoing follow-up.
- Build positive relationships with students and families while maintaining clear expectations for attendance, engagement, and academic progress.
- Track student contacts, barriers, interventions, attendance patterns, and outcomes; adjust supports when students are not demonstrating improvement.
- Support attendance improvement efforts for specific courses, sections, grade levels, or student groups experiencing attendance concerns.
- Collaborate with teachers, counselors, special education staff, interventionists, administrators, Bright Futures teacher, and other school staff to coordinate appropriate student supports and interventions.
- Participate in MTSS/RTI, grade-level, student support, attendance, and family meetings as appropriate.
- When regular LiveLesson attendance is not reasonably possible due to an ongoing barrier, work with the student, family, and teacher to establish an alternative engagement plan. This may include watching LiveLesson recordings, accessing instructional materials, completing related assignments or assessments, and maintaining communication with teachers.
- Monitor students using alternative engagement plans to ensure they are consistently accessing instruction, completing required work, and making academic progress.
- Analyze LiveLesson attendance trends and maintain reports, student lists, or other tools that provide teachers and school leaders with actionable attendance information.
- Support schoolwide strategies and communications designed to increase LiveLesson attendance and help students and families understand the connection between participation, engagement, and academic success.
- Maintain accurate records, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable school policies and procedures.
- Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor’s degree preferred, particularly in education, counseling, social work, psychology, youth development, or a related field.
- Experience working with middle and/or high school students, particularly students experiencing academic, attendance, engagement, or motivational challenges.
- Experience working with at-risk youth or providing student interventions is strongly preferred.
- Strong commitment to helping students overcome barriers and remain engaged in their education.
- Student-focused, relationship-centered approach.
- Demonstrated ability to build rapport with students and families while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Comfortable initiating frequent outreach to students and families, including situations where previous outreach attempts have been unsuccessful.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify individualized solutions to barriers affecting student participation.
- Strong organizational, project management, and follow-through skills.
- High level of attention to detail.
- Ability to manage and monitor a caseload of students requiring varying levels of intervention.
- Ability to analyze attendance and academic data and use that information to prioritize student support.
- Strong technology skills and ability to learn school data, communication, and instructional systems.
- Self-motivated and able to work independently in a virtual environment.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with teachers, counselors, administrators, and other school staff.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adjust priorities based on student needs.
- High degree of flexibility.
- Ability to work remotely as necessary.
- Willingness to occasionally work evening hours to accommodate student and family schedules.
- Ability to travel within Maine on an occasional basis if needed to support students, families, or school activities.

Salary Range: $42,500-$60,500

title: Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager
description:

We build trusted partnerships with clinicians, health systems, and companies worldwide to deliver validated AI solutions that enhance clinical confidence, accelerate discovery, prioritize precision care — and bring the future of cancer diagnostics within reach.

To find out how you could contribute to our mission to conquer cancer as a Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager please read on.

**Purpose:**

The Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager will own the development and execution of scalable education and engagement programs that enable customers to confidently adopt, optimize, and expand their use of Lunit breast software across USCAN, LATAM, and EU. This role translates customer needs, product capabilities, and clinical workflow requirements into high-impact learning experiences for radiologists, technologists, and clinical and operational teams. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Onboarding/Implementation, the Customer Education & Engagement Lead will build programs that support successful onboarding, on-time go-lives, sustained utilization, and long-term customer advocacy.

**What you'll be doing:**

- Lead the regional execution of customer education and engagement programs that drive adoption, proficiency, workflow optimization, and long-term utilization of Lunit breast software.
- Design and maintain scalable learning pathways for customer onboarding, go-live readiness, release-based training, advanced workflow optimization, and ongoing product enablement.
- Partner with Customer Onboarding/Implementation to embed training milestones, completion tracking, and readiness criteria into customer project plans to support successful deployments and revenue recognition timelines.
- Develop a comprehensive education calendar that includes live training, virtual sessions, on-demand modules, webinars, masterclasses, user group discussions, and customer community events.
- Create and maintain high-quality training materials, including e-learning modules, workflow simulations, video tutorials, quick-reference guides, facilitator materials, and customer-facing educational resources.
- Ensure education content remains aligned with product updates, the Lunit roadmap, regulatory requirements, and evolving breast imaging workflows and clinical guidelines.
- Partner with Marketing to launch customer education and thought-leadership programs that strengthen Lunit’s market presence, showcase customer expertise, and reinforce Lunit as a premium and innovative partner.
- Manage and optimize the Absorb LMS customer training experience, including enrollment paths, certification tracking, reporting, learner engagement, and consumption analytics.
- Leverage Higher Logic Vanilla to support digital community engagement, peer-to-peer learning, customer feedback loops, exclusive educational events, and champion cultivation.
- Build strong relationships with customer champions, clinical stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to ensure education programs reflect real-world customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
- Define, monitor, and report on education and engagement KPIs, including training completion, learner satisfaction, time-to-value, adoption indicators, community engagement, certification progress, and training impact.
- Collaborate with Clinical Affairs and Marketing to explore accredited CME or CE opportunities where appropriate and aligned with business objectives.
- Identify opportunities to use education as a customer success and commercial enablement tool, helping reduce churn risk, increase utilization, support renewals, and uncover expansion opportunities.

**What you will bring to the role:**

- Bachelor’s degree required in Clinical/Healthcare Sciences, Healthcare Administration, Instructional Design, Education, Business, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
- 5+ years of experience in customer education, clinical training, customer success enablement, professional education, instructional design, or customer engagement within MedTech, Healthcare IT, Medical Imaging, or SaaS environments.
- Experience supporting enterprise healthcare customers, imaging centers, radiology teams, or clinical software implementations strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to build scalable training programs, learning pathways, and customer-facing education assets from concept through execution.
- Strong understanding of medical imaging workflows, including PACS, RIS, radiology operations, and mammography or breast imaging environments; familiarity with AI clinical decision support tools is a plus.
- Working knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design practices, and modern learning delivery models, including live, virtual, on-demand, and blended learning.
- Hands-on experience with LMS administration, preferably Absorb LMS, including course configuration, learner enrollment, reporting, certification management, and analytics.
- Experience with digital community platforms, preferably Higher Logic Vanilla, and an understanding of how community engagement supports customer adoption and education.
- Proficiency with content authoring and training development tools such as Articulate Storyline/Rise, video tools, presentation platforms, and CRM or customer data systems such as Salesforce.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple education initiatives, customer deadlines, and cross-functional deliverables across regions.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with radiologists, technologists, executives, clinical stakeholders, and internal teams.
- High degree of customer empathy, operational discipline, and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering polished, practical, and measurable learning experiences.
- Ability to influence without authority and collaborate effectively across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Clinical Affairs, and Implementation teams.
- Fluency in English required; proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or key European languages is highly advantageous.
- Willingness to travel up to 30–40% across USCAN, LATAM, and EU for customer go-lives, site visits, trainings, and industry events.

**What you will receive:**

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per annum, full time equivalent. Benefits include the option to participate in medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances; a 401K plan with a company match; and generous paid time off.

**Other things to note:**

- This role will be hybrid if the successful applicant lives within commuting distance of our US office (Lynnwood, WA). For candidates outside this location, the role will be fully remote.
- Candidates must currently have the right to work in the United States to apply.
- Lunit International operates across multiple time zones, and this role may occasionally require working outside of standard business hours to support international customers or team collaboration. We offer flexible scheduling to help balance these needs with personal commitments/work life balance.
- Proof of COVID 19 vaccination required, except in limited circumstances where a legally recognized medical or religious exemption may be able to be accommodated.

We will endeavor to fill vacancies with the candidate who is the best fit for the role, without regard to gender, marital or family status, religious or ethical belief, race, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, political opinion, employment status, military status, sexual orientation or any other status protected by law.*

You’ll work with some of the brightest minds in the software and transportation industries. Our engineers and data scientists apply the latest in emerging tech, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to build smarter, more advanced tools for our diverse client base. We work with clients across the United States, with global ambitions in the years ahead.

As a Customer Education Specialist at Citian, you will be building our first customer training program including overall design and setup. You'll pick and configure our LMS, build self-guided learning paths for our two products, and create a program that our team can run with. Our users are traffic engineers, planners, and GIS analysts who are busy, smart, and often new to their roles in the public sector.  Providing training to these individuals has to be practical, user-friendly, and simple to adopt.  Our preference is to have this individual based in our D.C. office, but we are open to remote candidates as well.

**Responsibilities:**

- Interview customers and our CS team to define learner personas and the skills each role needs
- Evaluate and recommend a customer-facing LMS, then configure it

- Create content that explains how our data is built and why agencies can trust it, alongside product how-to content
- Build short, task-based modules: video, interactive walkthroughs, job aids, and knowledge checks
- Pilot the program with a few customers and measure completion, adoption, and feedback
- Deliver a maintenance playbook so our team can keep content current as the products change

**Qualifications:**

- 3+ years designing training for external customers of a software product (required)
- A portfolio showing self-paced or e-learning work you designed (required)
- Hands-on experience selecting or administering a customer-facing LMS, such as Skilljar, Thinkific, Docebo, or Northpass
- Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and self-directed learning
- Fluency with authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Camtasia, or Loom-style video
- Degree in instructional design, learning technology, or a related field (preferred)
- Experience with technical, data, GIS, or public-sector audiences (a strong plus)

**Your Citian Advantage:**

- Competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance and generous PTO.
- 401(k) company match and monthly commuter transportation benefit
- On-site gym and free snacks in the office
- High-growth potential and opportunities for advancement within a fast growing, venture-backed SaaS startup!

Let's build smarter cities together! Learn more about Citian here: www.citian.co

Additionally, they will contribute to ongoing team operations and broader initiatives to advance teaching and learning across the college.The ideal candidate is both a thoughtful designer and a confident consultant — someone who can listen carefully to understand each program’s needs and adapt their approach as projects evolve. - Assist faculty in creating course content and support faculty with effectively using the Canvas learning management system.

Education & Experience

**Position Title**
Instructional Designer & Learning Technology Specialist
  
  
**Job Category**
Academic Staff
  
  
**Employment Type**
Terminal (Fixed Term)
  
  
**Job Profile**
Instructional and Media Designer
  
  
**Job Duties**
The University of Wisconsin Oshkosh is seeking a collaborative and innovative Instructional Designer & Learning Technology Specialist to support the READY RURAL initiative. This position serves as the lead for instructional design, educational technology, digital learning, and multimedia development, partnering with faculty and subject matter experts to transform content into engaging, accessible, and workforce-focused learning experiences.
  
  
In this role, you will design and develop high-quality instructional materials for online, hybrid, face-to-face, simulation, mobile, and partner-based learning environments. You will create innovative learning resources that support rural healthcare education, including topics such as telehealth, virtual care, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health, home-based care, interprofessional practice, care coordination, and workforce readiness. The position also supports the development of stackable credentials, continuing education offerings, faculty development resources, and workforce training programs.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide consultation and support to faculty and staff on instructional technologies, digital learning tools, accessibility, and inclusive teaching practices. Responsibilities include developing multimedia resources such as instructional videos, simulations, interactive learning modules, digital toolkits, and tutorials, while ensuring all learning materials meet quality and accessibility standards.
  
  
This position also plays a key role in managing instructional design and media development projects by coordinating timelines, maintaining documentation and reusable resources, training faculty and project personnel on educational technologies, and supporting the collection and interpretation of data to continuously improve learning experiences and program effectiveness.
  
  
Universities of Wisconsin also offers an extremely competitive benefits package for 2026 that includes:
  
  

- Health plans, currently starting at $45 per month.
- 176 hours of vacation per year (prorated for start date).
- 36 hours of personal holiday, and 9 legal holidays (prorated for start date).

- Paid parental leave after six months of continuous employment.
- Wisconsin Retirement System (pension) with 7.2% employer contribution for 2026.

All employment benefits are subject to change. A full list of current benefits and eligibility requirements can be found on our website.
  
  
This position is funded through the READY RURAL grant and is initially offered as a one-year fixed-term appointment. The appointment is renewable annually for up to four years, contingent upon continued grant funding, satisfactory performance, and program needs.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities**

- Applies project management principles to course or media design such as defining project scope, establishing milestones, and tracking progress
- Provides pedagogical consultation services for instructors and staff on instructional toolsand technologies, best practices for digital instructional content, and institutional initiatives
- Establishes and maintains collaborative relationships with instructors and other academic staff to advance excellence in teaching and learning
- Reviews courses, media, or other learning products for quality using industry standardsand accessibility best practices

- Creates and maintains documentation on pedagogy, course or media design, templates, instructional technologies, and curates a library of shareable resources
- Designs and develops learning activities and course content using instructional technologies to foster inclusive and equitable student experiences

**Department**
College of Nursing, Health Professions and STEM
  
  
**Compensation**
Starting at $60,000 commensurate with experience
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Curriculum and Instruction, Learning Design, Media Production, Healthcare Education, or related field
- Experience designing online, hybrid, technology-enhanced, or multimedia learning experiences.
- Experience with learning management systems, digital learning tools, instructional technologies, or media production tools.
- Experience consulting with faculty, instructors, trainers, or subject matter experts.

title: Developer Relations Manager, Higher Education and Research - Foundational AI
description:

In this role, you will work directly with top researchers building frontier AI systems, including large language models, multimodal models, reasoning systems, training methods, inference systems, model serving, and scalable AI infrastructure. You will help researchers adopt NVIDIA’s AI and accelerated computing platforms to push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical credibility in foundational AI, strong research engagement experience, and hands-on expertise in either AI inference research or AI training research.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to leading academic AI labs working on foundation models, LLMs, multimodal AI, reasoning, training, inference, and AI systems.
- Identify high-impact research workloads where NVIDIA software, systems, and accelerated computing platforms can advance model performance, scale, and efficiency.
- Engage principal investigators, postdocs, graduate researchers, and lab leadership to understand research goals, technical blockers, infrastructure needs, and collaboration opportunities.
- Track frontier AI research across papers, benchmarks, open-source projects, and academic labs to identify emerging trends and future platform opportunities.
- Partner with Research Account Managers, Solution Architects, Product, Engineering, and Business Development teams to support researcher adoption and long-term engagement.
- Represent researcher needs internally by translating academic feedback into actionable insights for product roadmaps, developer programs, education, and platform strategy.
- Support NVIDIA participation in major AI, ML, and systems research venues through technical content, workshops, university engagements, and lab-facing programs.

  

**What we need to see:**

- PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent research experience.
- 5+ years of experience in the technology industry across software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI.
- Deep expertise in foundational AI, including LLMs, multimodal models, generative AI, reasoning, post-training, model evaluation, or AI systems research.
- Strong understanding of modern AI model development across the lifecycle, including pretraining, fine-tuning, post-training, optimization, evaluation, deployment, and model serving.
- Hands-on experience with AI research stacks such as PyTorch, JAX, distributed training frameworks, inference systems, model serving platforms, evaluation pipelines, and GPU-accelerated workflows.

- Familiarity with methods that improve model efficiency and performance, such as quantization, distillation, sparsity, speculative decoding, attention optimization, synthetic data generation, RLHF/RLAIF, and preference optimization.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

- Experience with NVIDIA AI platforms, including CUDA, CUDA-X libraries, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NIM, NeMo, Megatron, Transformer Engine, NCCL, DGX, NVLink, InfiniBand, or NVIDIA AI Enterprise.
- Established relationships with leading AI labs, academic institutions, research institutes, benchmark communities, or major open-source AI projects.
- Track record translating frontier AI research into demos, tutorials, reference architectures, workshops, technical blogs, or developer enablement programs.
- Experience presenting at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, AAAI , or related research workshops.
- Ability to identify emerging research trends and convert them into strategic opportunities for collaboration, platform adoption, and ecosystem growth.

The role includes researching source material, organizing technical information, writing and editing instructional content, and creating practice questions with answer explanations. You will help turn complex or unfamiliar material into content that is accurate, accessible, and useful to learners.

Commerce is looking for an
**Enterprise Training Manager, Technical Content**
to join our Training team. Reporting to the Manager, Training, this role sits at the intersection of technical content ownership and enterprise training delivery. The ideal candidate will own and maintain Commerce product and developer learning content — ensuring accuracy and relevance with each platform release — while also supporting personalized training for merchants, agency partners, and internal teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

- Continuously discover and implement new learning techniques and adult learning best practices to maximize engagement and instructional effectiveness.
- Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate content creation, improve efficiency, and enhance the learner experience.

- Deliver customized virtual and in-person training for enterprise merchants, agency partners, and internal teams as needed.

- Manage training action plans and coordinate scheduling and administration of learning sessions before, during, and after delivery.

- Solid technical foundation: comfortable with APIs and able to run API requests given API docs or a Postman library; familiar with front-end development tools and at ease with HTML/CSS/JS.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical topics clearly to audiences of all experience levels.
- Proactive, transparent communicator who is mindful of stakeholder needs across global, matrixed organizations.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple content projects independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.

title: Director, People Science and Insights
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

**The Role**

**Who We Are**

Join Kyndryl, the world’s largest technical services company, with 70,000 employees operating in over 60 countries and serving 75% of the Fortune 100 to modernize and manage the world’s mission-critical systems. Kyndryl provides advisory, implementation, and managed services to de-risk and support digital transformations. As our business innovates, our people strategy continues to evolve, and psychometrics plays a crucial role in shaping our enterprise success. Kyndryl is one of the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces®, and as a cutting-edge services company, we know our people drive our success.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Industrial-Organizational (I/O) Psychologist or Psychometrician to drive our talent and organizational analytics by People Science team to drive our talent and engagement analytics. Our business is to translate the skills inherent in our technical and consultative workforce into customer impact. We therefore seek to optimize the development and deployment of our employees’ skills, while providing industry-leading experience for our Kyndryls and our clients.

As our talent analytics capability matures beyond core operational reporting toward advanced analytics, this role bridges sophisticated statistical modeling with enterprise talent strategy. This work is fueled largely by our skills strategy and will support our recruiting, learning, engagement, performance management, leadership development, and overall organizational effectiveness. Specifically, you will oversee psychometric validation, continuous listening systems, and advanced talent analytics.

Kyndryl is a global, largely remote company, where you will join a group of 40 People and Workforce Analytics professionals and lead a team of 5 analysts and psychometricians. We are fast, flat, and focused. You will collaborate with dedicated engineering teams (who handle data wrangling), a diverse group of HR professionals, fellow data scientists, and business leaders. By working directly with senior leadership—including the CHRO, Head of Talent, and Head of Wellness—you will translate complex business problems into scientifically rigorous, high-impact solutions aligned with our business goals. Your work will directly influence our enterprise strategy and operations and impact on tens of thousands of employees.

**What You Will Do**

**Talent development and performance management:**

- Drive analytics to identify drivers of success to support processes and programs for employee and leadership development, including training, successful matching to projects, assessment tools, and leadership development efforts.
- Oversee psychometric modeling, assessment validation (e.g., Item Response Theory), and Organizational Network Analysis (ONA) leveraging skills graphs to optimize skill deployment.
- Design and refine performance management systems to support – as Kyndryl’s offerings increase in sophistication – the continued evolution of Kyndryl’s workforce.

**Organizational development and employee engagement:**

- Evaluate organizational networks and interactions and identify opportunities to improve workplace productivity, culture, and employee satisfaction.
- Lead enterprise employee listening strategies and survey architectures, developing and analyzing employee engagement surveys and continuous listening systems to inform continuous organizational effectiveness, enhance the employee experience, and ensure Kyndryl remains the employer of choice within the industry.

**Research, insight generation, and executive translation:**

- Conduct research to support the development and validation of new Talent analytics and strategies; incorporate new advancements and best practices into your work.
- Partner closely with senior executives (e.g., CHRO, C-suite, business unit leaders) to understand organizational challenges.
- Translate analytic results into actionable insights, framing and presenting findings through the lens of tangible business impact rather than pure academic research to inform technical and non-technical partners.

**Mentorship, collaboration, and team direction:**

- Manage and mentor a team of 5 analysts and psychometricians; provide direct coaching, oversight of technical deliverables, and drive the team's strategic roadmap.
- Collaborate with internal data science and engineering teams, HR experts, business leaders, and senior executives to understand business problems, problem-solve solutions, communicate insights, and deploy advanced analytical models smoothly into production.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

**Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

- **Experience & Analytical Rigor:** 7+ years of experience executing advanced analytics, including psychometric techniques (e.g., Item Response Theory), ONA leveraging skills graphs, and deploying models into production within large-scale enterprise environments. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
- **Leadership & Project Execution:** Proven prior management experience leading, mentoring, and developing analytics or technical personnel. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
- **Executive Stakeholder Management & Communication:** Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders to distill actionable analytics plans from complex business problems. Demonstrated track record of conveying complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences to drive executive strategy.
- **Programming & Technical Expertise:** Hands-on proficiency in statistical coding languages (specifically R, Python, SPSS, SAS, and Cypher/graph analytics) alongside working knowledge of ML modeling environments and platforms (e.g., Azure ML, Vortex AI AutoML, SageMaker).
- **Team & Organizational Fit:** Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively as part of a group of truly delightful and dedicated humans.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

- **Education:** Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Industrial-Organizational (I/O) Psychology, Psychometrics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (I/O Psychology or Psychometrics strongly preferred).
- **Industry Context:** Prior experience within professional services or fast-paced matrixed organizations.

**Compensation**

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $179,760 to $341,520 based on a full-time schedule.  Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience.  For part-time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California (San Francisco Bay Area): $215,640 to $409,800

California (All Other): $197,640 to $375,600

Colorado: $179,760 to $341,520

Massachusetts: $179,760 to $375,600

New York City: $215,640 to $409,800

Washington: $197,640 to $375,600

Washington DC: $197,640 to $375,600

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off.  Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

**Being You**

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

**Get Referred!**  
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Cloud Network Architect
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.
  
  
**About the role:**
The Cloud Network Architect is a strategic, customer-facing technical role responsible for ensuring the success of enterprise customers operating Aviatrix in production environments. As the primary technical point of contact, the Cloud Network Architect Trusted Advisor partners closely with customers to understand their architecture, guide best practices, and drive long-term platform adoption and health. This is not a sales role and focuses on customer outcomes and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities:**
Customer Engagement & Technical Ownership
  
  

- Serve as the dedicated Trusted Advisor for assigned strategic enterprise customers, acting as an extension of their cloud networking team.
- Own the end-to-end technical relationship including architecture design, deployment oversight, change management, and operational reviews.
- Lead regular business and technical reviews (QBRs/TBRs) with customer stakeholders, from network engineers to C-level executives.
- Proactively identify risks, gaps, and optimization opportunities within the customer's Aviatrix deployment.
- Drive customer adoption of Aviatrix platform capabilities, ensuring customers realize full value from their investment.

Cloud Network Architecture & Design
  
  

- Design and validate multi-cloud network architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) leveraging the Aviatrix platform.
- Guide customers through transit network design, hub-and-spoke topologies, segmentation, and inter-cloud connectivity.
- Collaborate with customer teams on BGP, SD-WAN, MPLS, and hybrid connectivity designs.
- Document reference architectures and operational runbooks tailored to each customer's environment.
- Advise on cloud cost optimization strategies related to network topology and traffic flows.

Network Security & Aviatrix DCF
  
  

- Design and implement cloud network security architectures using Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall (DCF).
- Define and enforce microsegmentation policies, security domains, and network-level access controls across multi-cloud environments.
- Architect and deploy DCF smart groups, security policies, and distributed stateful inspection to protect east-west and north-south traffic.
- Integrate Aviatrix DCF with third-party NGFW and security solutions (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point) for unified security posture.
- Guide customers on Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles and implementation using Aviatrix security capabilities.
- Drive adoption of Aviatrix ThreatIQ, network threat detection, and security analytics within customer environments.
- Support security compliance initiatives (SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) through proper network security policy design.
- Collaborate with customer security operations teams to align Aviatrix DCF policies with organizational security standards and compliance requirements.

Operations & Incident Management
  
  

- Act as the technical escalation point for critical incidents within the customer's Aviatrix environment.
- Drive rapid resolution of network and security incidents, coordinating with Aviatrix TAC and Engineering as needed.
- Monitor platform health, perform proactive issue identification, and implement preventative measures.
- Develop and execute change management plans for major upgrades, migrations, and new feature deployments.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership
  
  

- Serve as the voice of the customer internally — relay feedback, feature requests, and product gaps to Product and Engineering teams.
- Contribute to internal knowledge base, runbooks, and best-practice documentation for the Embedded Engineering team.
- Mentor junior team members and share expertise on cloud networking and security architecture.
- Engage with Aviatrix field and product teams to stay current on roadmap, and proactively position new capabilities to customers.

**Requirements**

- 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking, cloud networking, or network security roles.
- Hands-on expertise with at least two major public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) — including VPC/VNet design, transit gateways, and routing.
- Strong understanding of BGP, SD-WAN, MPLS, and hybrid cloud connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect).
- Experience with network security technologies: NGFWs, IDS/IPS, microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud-native security controls.
- Hands-on experience with Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall (DCF) — smart groups, security domains, stateful inspection, and policy enforcement — strongly preferred.
- Familiarity with cloud security compliance frameworks: SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST CSF.
- Proficiency with automation and scripting (Python, Terraform, Ansible) for network provisioning and operations.
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Datadog) applied to network and security telemetry.

The US national annual base salary range for this full-time position is $138,235 - $162,629 + benefits + 401(k) match + equity and is bonus eligible. The pay range is determined by the role, work location, job-related skills, level, experience and relevant education. The range displayed is applicable only for new hires for the listed position located in the US. Your Talent Advisor can share more details regarding salary ranges, benefits, and equity for your location during the hiring process.
  
  
**Benefits**
**US**
: We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long-term disability, life/AD&D insurance, $1,000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy.
  
  
**Outside the US:**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend
  
  
Your total compensation package will be based on job-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges.
  
  
**About Aviatrix**
**Aviatrix®**
is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world’s leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what’s next. Combined with the Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program, the industry’s leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud.
  
  
**WE WANT TO INCLUDE YOU**
We embrace the fact that not everyone’s journey took the same route or started at the same place. If your experience doesn’t quite meet the requirements but the opportunity excites you and you believe you could be great, don’t let that hold you back from applying. Aviatrix is a community where everyone's career can grow and we want to help you achieve your goals and be “your best YOU,” however that looks. description:

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**

The Senior Market Development Manager is a market-facing commercial leader for **new indications, customer bases, markets and platforms** — operating across the full spectrum from product development through early commercialization. This role builds early go-to-market strategy, validates product market fit, ensures the commercial perspective informs upstream decisions, and builds the market infrastructure required for successful future Intuitive launches. **This individual will focus on GI and endosurgical innovation.**

This role is deeply integrated with **engineering, product, clinical, regulatory, market access and corporate strategy teams** in both existing business units and future forward— serving as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and embedding market insight into product, clinical evidence, and market access roadmaps. Success requires equal fluency and trust in the external market and the internal development cycle.

The Senior Market Development Manager works directly with **physicians, hospital executives, payers, and societies** to identify unmet needs and shape clinical and commercial strategy. Where markets must be created rather than captured, this role is tasked with designing strategies to shift **patient pathways, referral patterns, and clinical beliefs** to unlock demand and accelerate commercial success.

**Essential Job Duties** (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)

- Serve as market-facing commercial lead throughout the upstream development cycle; bring commercial guidance to inform strategy and optimize launch success
- Refine product market fit with market insight
- Generate deep market, customer, and clinical insights; translate into actionable product and commercial recommendations aligned with the largest unmet clinical needs
- Partner with engineering, product, clinical, and corporate strategy teams to define and execute go-to-market strategy from product development through early commercialization; serve as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and influence product roadmap and prioritization
- Identify and engage KOLs, society leadership, and key stakeholders to shape market entry, build pre-market advocacy, and market seeding priming early adoption
- Support clinical and economic evidence-building to enable market access, value articulation, and regulatory/ reimbursement strategy; support transfer into ROI and economic value models
- Understand existing commercial strategy and ways of working across Intuitive- find opportunities to leverage existing expertise to accelerate adoption in new domains.
- Develop market creation strategies where skillsets are not transferable— design approaches to change patient referral pathways, shift clinical beliefs and behaviors, and build demand in spaces where historic strategic success may be less transferable
- Originate and develop creative market entry strategies for new clinical spaces — write the playbook for indications where no established commercial model exists
- Synthesize complex inputs into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership
- Develop commercialization strategy for new indications, including salesforce structure, go-to-market model, pricing, territory design, and sales incentive plan frameworks

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- 10 years of experience in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Market Development in MedTech
- Prior leadership experience required, including direct or matrixed leadership
- Demonstrated success operating in early-stage, ambiguous, or emerging market environments
- Capacity to rapidly upskill in clinical and technical knowledge base
- Experience building and executing go to market/ market creation strategy
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
- Experience building and leveraging KOL, society, and executive-level relationships
- Strong analytical, communication and executive presentation skills
- Ability to identify trends, distill themes, and translate customer preference to strategic priorities
- Familiarity with clinical pathways, hospital economics, capital strategy, and enterprise decision-making

**Required Education and Training:**

- Bachelor’s degree required

**Working Conditions:**

- Global travel required

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

- GI experience
- Exposure to early product development, market shaping, or pre-launch commercialization working with engineers
- Experience with surgical and/or endoscopic procedures preferred
- Strategic clinical and reimbursement experience; payer fluency
- Global or international experience

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.
