title: Implementation Lead
description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

**Role Summary**

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

**What You'll Do**

- Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers
- Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation
- Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions
- Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes
- Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices
- Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value
- Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery
- Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features
- Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities
- Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact
- Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

- **45 days**
  : Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.
- **60 days:**
  Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.
- **90 days:**
  Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation
- **6 months**
  : Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.
- **1 year:**
  Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

**Who You Are**

- 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.
- Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.
- Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.
- Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
- Collaborative team player who can also operate independently
- Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
- Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

**Perks and Benefits**

- Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
- Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
- Generous professional development budget
- RRSP/ 401k matching program
- Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

title: Key Account Manager (KAM) - Hospitals; Anti-infectives - Detroit, MI
description:
The KAM position is focused on establishing access and demand for a novel hospital antibiotic product to hospitals and hospital systems within an assigned territory. This includes educating formulary decision makers, key stakeholders, and clinicians on the clinical benefits of the product and establishing and gaining formulary adoption within the institutional IV antibiotic space. The KAM will be responsible for formulary access and sales at the top institutions in the U.S.
  
  
KAMs are responsible for calling on a variety of targeted healthcare professionals within the institutional setting, planning, implementing and taking ownership of their territory plans to enhance institutional awareness and access to Shionogi’s Anti-infective product(s). To do this successfully, they must have a deep understanding of how to navigate these institutions and systems in order to gain access to and impact these key decision makers.
  
  
The ideal KAM should have a strong knowledge base in infectious disease, microbiology and how hospital products are purchased, ordered, administered and established for formulary inclusion within the hospital setting. The ability to communicate complex clinical data to ID physicians, Pharmacists and microbiology labs is key, in order to demonstrate competence and communication of a highly scientific space to evidence driven stakeholders. KAMs are also required to understand the formulary process and reimbursement policies for targeted institutions and systems. The KAMs should also possess strong analytical skills and embrace opportunities for growth and expanded responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Establish clinical understanding and demand within ID physician, pharmacist and microbiology community for target accounts.
- Promote product in the geographical area by navigating the institutional formulary approval process, as well as educating customers on appropriate use of products.
- Understand and leverage the access landscape to establish/expand institutional product access through effective engagement with Pharmacy Directors, ID Pharmacists, ID Physicians, Microbiologists, and other key customers.
- Effectively and consistently call on and educate physicians and other stakeholders within targeted institutions on the use of Shionogi’s anti-infective product(s) through one-on-one meetings and presentations, professional education programs and other appropriate means.
- Deep knowledge of hospital practices including formulary management and pharmaceutical product review.
- Establish professional relationships and maintain an effective communication network with the customer at multiple levels, including ID opinion leaders, key hospital medical staff, pharmacies and more.
- Create opportunities for product education while enhancing Shionogi’s image and commitment to medicine, working directly with local/regional thought leaders and professional societies.
- Responsible for ensuring high level of call and field productivity; expected to meet and exceed expectations for call plans, with five full-time days in the field each week.
- Collaborate with Regional Account Management, Market Access Leadership, Medical Affairs, and Marketing on all needs and opportunities, KOL touch points, and formulary changes.
- Identify and communicate field issues, opportunities and competitive activities through appropriate organizational venues.
- Achieve formulary adoption goals within territory while adhering to all ethical market access practices and required regulations.
- Execute brand strategies to ensure a consistent company marketing message.
- Analyze territory information and insights to develop and execute effective account plans, optimize routing, and maximize field resources to achieve results.
- Responsible for accurately reporting field activities, territory expenses and submitting written reports as necessary by the deadline set forth and defined by Shionogi management.
- Develop positive and interactive relationships with peers, customer and company managers
- Perform Company business in accordance with all regulations (i.e., PDMA/Sample), Company policy and procedures. Demonstrates high ethical and professional standards at all times.
- Actively pursue continuous learning and professional development on efficient sales, communication, managed care and product knowledge training.
- Appropriately manage and maintain all company equipment and promotional materials (company literature, computer, etc.) according to necessary company guidelines.
- Attend all company-sponsored meetings as directed by company management (POAs, National Meetings, National/Regional Conventions, etc.). In-person attendance may be required according to most current company policy.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
**Qualifications**

- BS/BA degree required.
- Hospital-based pharmaceutical experience is required.
- Demonstrated experience in hospital or health system environments with anti-infective, critical care or intravenous experience is strongly preferred.
- Must successfully complete all relevant training and certify in product knowledge for the assigned product(s) within a reasonable time frame.
- Strong understanding of how hospital products are purchased, ordered and administered which include knowledge of the formulary process and reimbursement policies.
- Ability to understand and navigate hospital systems in order to gain access to key decision makers.
- Experience in building rapport and relationships within the institutional setting in order expand awareness and utilization of product(s) and make an immediate impact on healthcare professionals
- Demonstrated track record of successful facilitation of educational programs.
- Ability to communicate clinical data in order to demonstrate competence and communication of a high-level scientific product.
- Successful hospital antibiotic launch experience is a plus.
- Successful experience in establishing hospital product formulary approval through P & T (pharmacy and therapeutic committees) within the IV antibiotic or related category.
- Successful experience with the coordination of account related events.
- Business to business experience and/or ability to demonstrate strong influencing skills.
- Documented record of performance and achievement.

**Competencies**

- Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.
- Strong organizational, interpersonal and listening skills.
- Thrives in an ever-changing environment.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate internally as a team member to deliver results.
- Proactive; can do approach, takes ownership of situations.
- Demonstrated self-starter, highly motivated, problem-solving skills.
- Digital competence; ability to deliver presentations digitally using iPad.
- Proficient in MS Office Suite; Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.

**Other Requirements**

- Must reside within the boundaries of the assigned geographic territory.
- Driving in a safe manner to required meetings and appointments.
- Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and ability to pass a complete background check.
- Must have valid licenses and credentialing required to conduct business in assigned territory.
- Ability and willingness to travel approximately 80% of the year.
- Ability to drive or fly to various meetings and conventions.
- Some overnight and/or weekend travel may be required.

**Essential Physical And Mental Requirements**- Ability to articulate clearly and conduct verbal presentations with large and small audiences.
- Ability to travel via automobile and/or airplane.
Ability to view video display terminal images < 18” away from face for extended period of time – up to four (4) hours at a time.- Ability to operate a computer keyboard and telephone.
- Ability to sit for extended periods of time – up to four (4) hours at a time.
- Ability to lift, tug, pull up to fifteen (15) pounds.
Additional Information
  
  
The base salary range for this full-time, field-based position is $155,000-$180,000. Individual pay is determined by several factors, which include but are not limited to: job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range does not include the comprehensive benefits, vehicle allowance, bonus, long-term incentive, or any additional compensation that may be associated with this role.

title: Customer Support Specialist, Infinity
description:

As a Customer Support Specialist, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for a portfolio of 20 to 40 clients across the United States and Canada. You will provide timely, accurate, and professional support while troubleshooting technical issues and helping users make the most of a highly customizable software platform. The role combines customer service, technical problem-solving, product knowledge, and ongoing client education. You will manage support requests across phone, chat, and email while collaborating with Developers and Business Analysts on complex issues. You will also contribute to knowledge sharing, product feedback, and continuous improvements to support processes. This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity with a collaborative environment and opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.

- Provide professional and accurate assistance on a wide range of requests, from password resets and functionality questions to more complex technical issues.
- Deliver real-time customer support and maintain consistent follow-up to ensure timely resolution and a positive client experience.

- Participate actively in team meetings, training sessions, webinars, and knowledge-sharing activities.
- Gather and communicate client feedback and enhancement requests to Product and Development teams.
- Support customers through product updates and new releases by providing guidance and training on new functionality.
- Contribute to continuous learning, documentation, knowledge sharing, and improvements to support processes and workflows.

- Availability to work from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time (PST).
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, databases, and remote access tools.
- Ability to quickly learn new technologies, software releases, and product functionality.

title: Client Experience Manager – Early Morning + Flexible Schedule (Full-Time, Remote | B2B SaaS)
description:

Looking to bring your clinical experience into healthcare technology—with a schedule that gives you more flexibility? This fully remote, full-time role combines a consistent early morning shift with the freedom to choose when you work the remaining four hours of your day.
  
  
**You’ll work Monday–Friday, with required coverage from 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. You choose when to work your remaining four hours later that day, provided they are worked in one consecutive block. Weekends are off.**

This role is an unprecedented opportunity to have an immense impact on our industry leading Client Success Team that ranks 85 Net Promoter Score points higher than our competition (in other words, people love Prompt). We’re looking for someone scrappy, willing to bring new ideas, take on big challenges, and interested in doubling down on what works.
  
  
We’re doing something special here, and this role will be critical in taking Prompt to the next level.
  
  
**Hours & Schedule: Built Around an Early Start, With Flexibility After**
This is a full-time, eight-hour-per-day role with a Monday–Friday schedule:
  
  

- Your fixed hours: 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time each weekday.
- Your flexible hours: You choose when to work an additional four consecutive hours later that same day.
- Your weekends: Saturdays and Sundays off.

Want to keep your workday together? Your additional block could follow your morning coverage. Prefer a longer break between blocks? You could return for a four-hour afternoon or evening block.
  
  
**The flexibility is in when you work your second block.**
Those four hours must be worked consecutively, rather than split into smaller increments, and you’ll be actively available to support customers throughout both work blocks.
  
  
**Why Work for Prompt?**

- BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.
- Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance. It's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.
- Healthy Approach: At Prompt, we value smart work and ownership. This role pairs consistent early morning coverage with meaningful flexibility in how you schedule the rest of your workday.
- Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back every day, but it does feel good :)

**The Role**
You’ll provide customer support through our email support channel, including essential early morning coverage as clinics begin their day. You’ll handle incoming tickets, investigate reported issues, identify trends, and collaborate with Engineering to log, prioritize, and communicate about issues effectively.
  
  
You’ll act as the bridge between customer experience and product stability, helping clinics navigate questions and resolve issues, including those that arise following product releases.
  
  
Within six months, you’ll have established yourself as a key contributor—comfortable supporting both the clinical and billing sides of the software—by demonstrating initiative, technical understanding, and exceptional communication skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our product offerings to effectively respond to incoming customer inquiries across our single-channel support system.
- Provide timely, accurate customer support through our email support channel during your early morning coverage and additional scheduled work block.
- Work primarily within the clinical side of the platform while maintaining a working knowledge of billing modules to identify, document, and escalate billing issues.
- Troubleshoot software issues, gather detailed replication steps, and write clear, actionable engineering tickets; collaborate with Engineering to prioritize and monitor resolutions.
- Proactively identify and escalate urgent issues that impact production environments or multiple customers.
- Contribute to internal process improvements and knowledge base updates to enhance support efficiency and scalability.
- Promote customer satisfaction and advocate for an exceptional experience by understanding each customer’s unique needs, delivering value in every interaction, and identifying opportunities to enhance our product and service features.
- Take on tasks beyond defined job responsibilities as needed, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
- Collaborate closely with the rest of the CX team to ensure clear handoffs and continuity on customer issues and follow-ups.

**Minimum Requirements**

- Experience as a rehab clinician, such as an SLP, OT, PT, COTA, or PTA.
- Availability to work Monday–Friday from 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time, plus an additional four consecutive hours later each day.
- Highly analytical mindset with a strong ability to troubleshoot and test software use cases and issues.
- Proactive, self-motivated, and resourceful learner capable of working independently with limited oversight.
- Experience thriving in dynamic work settings that demand adaptability and efficiency.
- Comfort working in a fast-paced environment and prioritizing customer needs.
- High proficiency in MS Excel.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Qualifications**

- 1–3 years of experience on a Support or CX team.
- Prior startup and/or B2B SaaS organization experience.
- Knowledge of e-clinical systems and technologies, such as EMR, RTM, HEP, CRM, and HIEs.
- Comfort handling cross-functional communication with Engineering and Product teams.
- Technical proficiency with foundational device and network troubleshooting.
- Proven ability to handle multiple projects, shift gears quickly, and meet deadlines while maintaining professional composure.
- Experience with Zendesk or similar customer support software.

**Perks – What You Can Expect**

- Competitive salaries
- Fully remote role
- Flexible scheduling following your required early morning coverage
- Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

title: Principal EP Mapping Specialist - CAS
description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.
  
  
Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.
  
  
Join Medtronic as an EP Mapping Specialist and be at the forefront of transforming lives through advanced medical technology! In this dynamic role, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team of clinicians, engineers, physicians, and innovators to execute solutions for cardiac and other electrophysiological systems. By blending technical expertise with a passion for improving patient outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to impact global healthcare directly. If you're driven by precision, problem-solving, and the chance to make a tangible difference in people’s lives, this is your opportunity to grow your career while shaping the future of medical innovation at Medtronic.

- Develop and cultivate customer relationships resulting in incremental business.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About The Role**
A Solutions Architect, internally titled a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, doesn't build generic capability for a broad market — they embed with one strategic customer and make the platform work inside that customer's actual environment, against that customer's real data, APIs, and constraints. That's this role.
  
  
You'll be embedded onsite with the customer's security team, working directly out of their offices rather than through requirements documents and ticket handoffs. Your job is to close the gap between what the Zenity platform can do in the abstract and what the customer's team needs it to do inside their AI and data platforms and their broader environment. That means gathering requirements straight from the people using the product, designing and building solutions that fit their environment, integrating against the customer's own systems and identity patterns, and staying accountable for the outcome — not just the handoff.
  
  
This is closer to running a security and engineering program inside the customer's organization than it is to shipping a roadmap feature. You'll operate with a lot of autonomy in a space where the playbook is still being written, and you'll be the one writing it.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Do**

- Gather requirements in the field. Sit with the customer's security team directly — in their office, on their calls — to figure out what's actually blocking a deployment, not what a ticket says is blocking it.
- Customize and configure the solution for this customer's workflow, not the general market. If the customer's platforms need Zenity to behave differently than it does for anyone else, you make that happen.
- Integrate with the customer's own data, APIs, infrastructure, and identity/access patterns. You're working inside their systems, not asking them to adapt to yours.
- Test, troubleshoot, and iterate alongside the customer — sometimes live, with stakeholders watching and a fix expected before the call ends.
- Feed what you learn back into the core product. When you build the same workaround twice, that's a signal the platform is missing something. You're the mechanism by which the field changes the roadmap, not just a consumer of it.
- Own the outcome end to end — from the first ambiguous ask through to a deployment that's actually working and staying that way.
- Lead the customer in best practices for a category that's still being defined. AI agent security doesn't have an established playbook yet — you're often the one bringing structure and precedent to the customer's team. Partner closely with the account's Customer Success Manager to make sure that guidance lands consistently, from initial rollout through ongoing maturity.

**Core Requirements Of The Role**

- Deployment support. Support the customer's infrastructure teams in deploying Zenity's new features (e.g., Outpost, Azure AI Foundry) alongside the customer's engineering teams across India and the US.
- Testing & validation. Support the customer's team in testing and validating Zenity's new detections across new platforms — Azure AI Foundry, Fabric, and LLM features — inside the customer's tenants, ensuring full execution context is available for analysis.
- Technical translation & advocacy. Translate the customer's observations, needs, and troubleshooting findings into precise, reproducible engineering detail — surfacing the right resource types, telemetry, and execution context so Zenity engineering can act without repeated round-trips — and advocate for the customer's requirements and priorities in Zenity's roadmap.
- Security investigations. Lead security investigations arising from validation efforts, create and manage associated security incidents, and drive them through to resolution.
- Single point of contact & liaison. Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison between the customer's team and Zenity for all support issues raised during testing — coordinating timely closure of bugs, stories, and incidents.
- Cadence & accountability. Run weekly sync meetings with the customer and Zenity teams to review open issues, track progress, and ensure accountability through to closure.

What You’ll Do:
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

- Strong technical fundamentals first. You're comfortable designing and configuring solutions hands-on; this is a technical role, not a sales or consulting role wearing an engineering title.
- Comfort with ambiguity. The customer won't hand you a clean spec. You'll be the one imposing structure on a vague, high-stakes problem.
- Customer-facing engineering experience — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services Engineering, or Technical Consulting.
- A track record of building, not just maintaining — systems, integrations, or relationships.
- Genuine comfort being the technical face of Zenity onsite, day to day, inside a partner's building.
- Background in cybersecurity, cloud security, governance, or enterprise SaaS, and ideally hands-on exposure to the customer's core productivity, AI, and data platforms.
- Experience building AI-powered applications, agentic systems, or AI governance tooling.
- Startup or high-growth experience, and the instinct to move fast without a mature playbook.
- Strong communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders — you'll go from a working session with the security team to explaining a tradeoff to a non-technical leader in the same day.

What We Look For At Zenity:
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Complex platforms don't sell themselves into production — they stall the moment they meet a real customer's data, security posture, and undocumented processes. That's the gap Forward Deployed Engineering closes, and at Zenity it means embedding with one of our most strategic partners to make AI agent security actually work inside their infrastructure, not just in a demo.
  
  

- Help define the emerging category of AI security and governance.
- Work embedded with one of our most strategic partners.
- Solve genuinely hard problems at the frontier of AI adoption.
- Shape both customer success and product direction — your fieldwork feeds the roadmap.
- Join a world-class team building the future of secure AI.

Interview Process:
  
  
Our interview process is designed to be transparent, conversational, and focused on real-world experience.
  
  

- Recruiter Interview
- Hiring Manager Interview
- Director of Engineering Interview
- CRO interview
- Final interview with the customer team

Zenity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We enable enterprises to adopt AI agents securely and at scale, and that starts with building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work, securely, confidently, and with impact.
  
  
Compensation:
  
  
The base salary range for this role is $190,000 to $220,000. Final offer within the range depends on experience, skills, and interview performance. This role also includes equity and Zenity's full benefits package.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About The Role**
**Customer Success Manager**
(Home based with some travel to client site)
  
  
**Help some of the world's largest organisations turn learning into lasting impact**
AI, technology and digital capability are changing how organisations operate, compete, and grow. But transformation only works if businesses have the people and skills to deliver it and can turn that investment into meaningful results.
  
  
That is where QA comes in.
  
  
QA is the UK’s largest technology training provider, working with 96% of the FTSE and most Fortune 500 companies to help organisations build the AI, technology, digital and human skills they need for the future.
  
  
In the last three years alone, QA has supported 4,000+ organisations and more than one million learners. And as businesses continue to invest in AI, data, cloud, cyber security and digital transformation, ensuring those investments deliver real value is more important than ever.
  
  
That creates a significant opportunity for experienced customer-focused professionals who know how to build strong partnerships, navigate complexity and turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Where you come in**
As a Customer Success Manager, you'll take ownership of the operational relationships across a portfolio of strategic customers, making sure they get the greatest possible value from working with QA.
  
  
Your job is to understand what success looks like for each organisation, build the relationships needed to deliver it and ensure QA consistently meets its commitments.
  
  
You'll work closely with senior stakeholders, becoming a trusted partner who understands their priorities, anticipates challenges and helps them achieve their wider workforce and learning objectives. You'll have ownership of customer success, from contract performance and service delivery through to retention, adoption and long-term account development.
  
  
**You'll Work Across QA's Learning Portfolio, Which Includes**

- Apprenticeships
- Instructor-led training
- Self-paced learning
- Hands-on labs

You'll need to balance strong customer relationships with commercial outcomes, identifying risks early, protecting existing business and working alongside our sales teams to uncover opportunities for further growth.
  
  
But you'll be doing that with an established customer portfolio, a highly relevant proposition and the opportunity to influence how some of the largest organisations in the UK and globally develop their people.
  
  
**What**
**you'll be doing**
You'll take ownership of delivering meaningful outcomes across your customer portfolio by:
  
  

- Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and becoming a key partner in their learning and workforce development strategies
- Understanding customer goals, success measures and business priorities to develop and deliver effective customer success plans
- Owning contract performance, customer retention and service commitments, ensuring customers receive the value they expect
- Working across QA's internal teams to coordinate delivery, resolve challenges and maintain a consistently strong customer experience
- Using customer insights, performance data and feedback to demonstrate value, measure outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement
- Proactively identifying risks to customer satisfaction, contract delivery or retention and taking ownership of finding solutions
- Supporting commercial growth by identifying wider customer needs and working with sales teams to develop opportunities across QA's portfolio
- Driving continuous improvement in how we support customers, while sharing your knowledge and experience with the wider Customer Success team

**A market with genuine momentum**
The skills agenda has moved significantly. AI adoption, digital transformation and emerging technology are creating new capability gaps across almost every industry.
  
  
Organisations are investing in learning and workforce development, but that investment needs to deliver more than completed training programmes.
  
  
They need to see the impact on their people, their capabilities and their wider business objectives.
  
  
QA helps them do that.
  
  
As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be at the heart of making that happen.
  
  
You'll work with customers to understand what they are trying to achieve, ensure their programmes deliver against those expectations and help demonstrate the value of their investment.
  
  
And with QA already supporting some of the world's largest organisations, you'll have the opportunity to develop meaningful partnerships across a broad range of industries and complex customer environments.
  
  
**We'll**
**invest in your development too**
QA is a learning business, so development is not just something we sell to customers.
  
  
**You'll Have The Opportunity To**

- Access QA-authored technology and business learning
- Develop your knowledge of emerging areas including AI, data, cloud and cyber security
- Build your strategic customer relationship and commercial management capabilities
- Gain exposure to complex customer environments and large-scale learning programmes
- Work alongside experienced specialists across sales, delivery and the wider business
- Share your expertise and contribute to the development of the Customer Success team

You'll be expected to bring experience, curiosity and the confidence to take ownership.
  
  
QA will give you the environment, expertise and opportunity to build on that.
  
  
**Who tends to do well here?**
**We're Looking For People Who Are**

- Passionate about delivering meaningful customer outcomes
- Confident building relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
- Commercially minded, with an understanding of retention, contract performance and customer value
- Comfortable managing complex customer relationships and competing priorities
- Proactive in anticipating challenges and finding solutions
- Curious about how organisations operate and what success looks like for them
- Confident using data and customer insights to inform decisions and demonstrate value
- Strong at bringing different teams together to achieve shared goals
- Organised, accountable and comfortable taking ownership
- Motivated by building long-term partnerships rather than simply managing transactions

You should be able to demonstrate how you've managed complex customer needs, built credibility with stakeholders and made a measurable difference to customer satisfaction, retention or performance.
  
  
Experience within learning, technology or workforce development would be valuable, but isn't essential.
  
  
More important is your ability to understand what customers need, bring the right people together and take ownership of delivering against those expectations.
  
  
**The opportunity**
If you enjoy developing meaningful customer relationships, solving complex challenges and seeing the impact of your work, this is an opportunity to do that with some of the UK's most recognised organisations.
  
  
You'll have ownership of strategic customer relationships, access to a broad portfolio of learning solutions and the opportunity to influence how organisations develop the skills they need for the future.
  
  
You'll be joining a team where customer outcomes matter, collaboration is essential and your ability to create long-term value makes a genuine difference.
  
  
**About Us**
**Wellbeing & benefits**
Your wellbeing matters to us. That’s why we offer benefits designed to help you recharge and thrive, including:
  
  

- 27 days Annual Leave (4 days used for the festive closure) plus Bank Holidays
- Holiday Buying scheme
- Medicash plan, Wellhub, Cycle to Work scheme
- Private Medical Insurance at corporate rates
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Employee Discounts Benefit Hub
- 3 Development days
- 2 Charity days per year
- Pension Scheme
- Early Friday Finish at 4pm

**Personal growth**

Learning and opportunity are at the core of what we do - and that applies to you too!
  
  
You’ll have the unique opportunity to develop your skills on our QA  authored courses in the latest tech (you’ll get 3 training days/year to do this). You can also delve deep into our world-class digital learning content on a variety of tech and business topics. Or perhaps you’d like to enrol on a Degree or Masters programme to enhance your skillset or learn new things.
  
  
**Our people**

We are an equal opportunity employer, focused on promoting a welcoming and inclusive environment. We embrace diversity, welcome applications from all candidates and aim to support the career growth of everyone.
  
  
This means no matter what your gender, age, ethnicity, beliefs, or sexual orientation, or if you are disabled or a carer, we welcome you and the different perspectives you bring to our diverse family. We’re proud of the progress we’ve achieved over the last few years to build an inclusive culture and celebrate our diversity.
  
  
As a Disability Confident Employer, we guarantee that all applicants with a disability who meet the role criteria will progress to the next stage of the process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.
  
  
**Our Mission**

We teach the critical AI, technology, digital and Human skills needed to transform and succeed in a changing world. We do this through tailored learning programmes that connect learning across an organisation, create continuity for learners, and feature collaborative, cohort-based modalities to apply skills at pace and at scale.
  
  
Our unique end-to-end learning solutions draw from deep expertise across Apprenticeships, Instructor-led training, Self-paced Learning and Blended Learning.
  
  
You can find out more about us at https://www.qa.com/about/careers/

title: Senior Manager, Customer Expansion
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

### **About the Role**

As we scale our post-sale organization, we’re seeking a **Senior Manager, Customer Expansion** to build and lead our expansion motion across Dandy’s existing customer base.

The team combines proactive BDR-led outbound with high-touch events, training, and field motions that help customers adopt additional products and unlock more value from Dandy.

This role is equal parts **strategic builder and people leader**. You’ll build the operating model and playbooks, lead through frontline managers across BDR and STS teams, and partner closely with Account Management, Training, Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to make expansion a repeatable, scalable revenue motion.

We’re looking for a strong operator who knows how to **build teams, create clarity, coach leaders, and get things done**. This isn’t about running an existing sales machine—we’re looking for someone who can build one.

### **What You'll Do**

- **Build and lead the Expansion organization**, developing a high-performing team through frontline leaders across BDR and STS (Sales & Training Specialist) functions
- Develop and refine **repeatable expansion playbooks** across Dandy’s product portfolio, from customer identification and outbound through product education and activation
- Build the **BDR-to-STS motion** and the **playbook for events, in-person trainings**, and other high-touch expansion opportunities
- Establish the team's **operating cadence, metrics, and accountability systems**, using leading indicators to identify gaps and drive action
- Partner with Account Management, Sales, Training, Marketing, Product, and RevOps to identify opportunities and remove friction from the expansion journey
- Build feedback loops to understand **what is working, where customers are getting stuck, and which motions should scale**
- Test, iterate, and operationalize new expansion motions as the business evolves

### **What We're Looking For**

- 5+ years of B2B sales, customer growth, or related commercial experience, with **3+ years managing and developing sales teams and frontline leaders**
- Proven track record of **building and scaling teams**, ideally in a high-growth or evolving environment
- Strong **operational discipline**—you naturally bring structure to ambiguous problems, establish clear metrics, and follow through on execution
- Strong **commercial instincts** and an understanding of how to translate customer engagement into **revenue, adoption, and retention**
- Strong ability to build **processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms** from scratch
- **High agency** and a bias toward action
- **Excellent cross-functional communication** and ability to operate effectively across strategy and execution

### **Bonus Points For**

- Experience building an **expansion, cross-sell, account growth, or customer revenue** motion
- Experience managing BDR and/or STS teams through frontline leaders
- Experience with **events, field sales, customer training, or other high-touch commercial motions**
- Experience operating across both SMB and Enterprise
- Familiarity with dental, healthcare, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

title: Sr Director, Partner Sales - Solutions Consultant
description:
At TreviPay, we believe loyalty begins at the payment. Thousands of sellers use our global B2B payments and invoicing network to provide choice and convenience to buyers, open new markets and automate accounts receivables. With integrations to top eCommerce and ERP solutions and flexible trade credit options, TreviPay brings 40 years of experience serving leaders in manufacturing, retail and transportation.  
  
Every day, TreviPay employees are challenged and empowered in a supportive, collaborative, entrepreneurial environment.

**At TreviPay, we believe loyalty begins at the payment.** Thousands of sellers use our global B2B payments and invoicing network to provide choice and convenience to buyers, open new markets, and automate accounts receivable. With integrations to top eCommerce and ERP solutions and flexible trade credit options, TreviPay brings 40+ years of experience serving industry leaders in manufacturing, retail, travel and transportation. Every day, TreviPay employees are challenged and empowered in a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.

### **What will I be doing?**

The Senior Director of Partner Sales is a senior, customer-facing leader responsible for growing TreviPay's business through financial institution and card issuer partners. This remote role combines partner sales leadership, commercial card expertise, solution consulting, enterprise business development and strategic account growth. The role develops trusted relationships with partner sales organizations, equips bankers and relationship managers to identify opportunities, and leads qualified opportunities through discovery, demonstration, solution design and close.

Success requires a coach-and-closer mindset: multiplying partner effectiveness while personally adding value at critical points in the sales cycle. The VP will build joint territory and account plans, activate partner-sourced pipeline, influence complex buying groups and support revenue and profitability goals through a disciplined, consultative sales motion.

### **Responsibilities:**

- **Lead FI partner sales strategy:** Develop and execute commercial and sales strategies for financial institution and issuer channels, including strategic account plans, sales KPIs, pipeline growth, revenue forecasts and annual goals.
- **Enable partner sales teams:** Build and deliver training, playbooks, battlecards, presentations and other enablement resources that help bankers, treasury sales officers and product partners recognize qualifying opportunities and communicate TreviPay's value proposition credibly.
- **Build joint pipeline:** Partner with FI sales teams on account mapping, detailed relationship planning, campaign support and pipeline reviews to identify retention, expansion and new-client opportunities within the partner's commercial portfolio.
- **Lead consultative selling and solution design:** Develop a thorough understanding of TreviPay's B2B payments and invoicing solutions and clearly communicate value to clients and their customers. Use insight-based selling to connect payment solutions to measurable business needs.
- **Advance complex opportunities:** Lead investigation, discovery, product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, presentations and deal development for qualified opportunities. Sell effectively to the different personas within large-enterprise buying groups and collaborate with the internal selling team throughout longer sales cycles.
- **Develop strategic relationships:** Foster trusted relationships with partner sales leadership, bankers, relationship managers, product partners and client stakeholders, including C-suite decision-makers. Represent TreviPay professionally in all interactions.
- **Drive commercial outcomes:** Achieve or exceed revenue and profitability goals, maintain an accurate working forecast, and derive strategic account plans from partner and client go-to-market strategies.
- **Support co-marketing and partner activation:** Collaborate with Marketing on partner-facing collateral, campaigns and incentive structures designed to increase partner engagement and prioritize TreviPay solutions.
- **Create executive-ready communications:** Develop presentations for partner enablement, end-user training, conferences, client meetings and internal updates, adapting complex information for varied audiences.

### **What do I need to succeed?**

#### **Essential**

- 8+ years of experience in channel sales, partner enablement, sales engineering, solutions consulting, commercial card, B2B payments, banking technology or a related financial solutions environment.
- Significant experience developing and implementing commercial or sales strategy, with a proven track record of success.
- Experience selling financial solutions and communicating complex payment concepts in a clear, concise and persuasive way.
- Proven ability to lead consultative discovery, demonstrations and presentations with senior stakeholders and complex buying groups.
- Excellent relationship-building skills across partner sales organizations, internal teams and enterprise clients.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.
- Highly organized, responsive and able to prioritize, problem-solve and operate effectively in a matrix environment.
- Ability to travel up to 40%.

#### **Desirable**

- Experience working with or within a bank, card issuer or commercial card sales organization.
- Experience building partner enablement content, including playbooks, battlecards, training or certification programs.
- Deep understanding of B2B payments, order to cash cycles, invoicing, commercial card or payment processing solutions.
- Bachelor's degree in business or a related field.

Why you will love working at TreviPay

- Competitive salary
- Paid parental leave
- Generous paid time off
- Medical, dental, vision, FSA, Life/AD&D, long and short term disability
- 401K matching
- Employee referral program

At TreviPay we believe:

- in saying yes to unique and challenging requirements
- empowered team members are creative team members
- our products make the customer’s day just a little bit better
- work/life balance makes us all more effective

title: IT Support Specialist II
description:
COG Research Foundation, LLC (Research Foundation) is a California 501(c)(3) entity founded in 2024 to serve as a fiscal sponsor to support research programs by providing legal, fiduciary, and administrative oversight for the program. The Research Foundation serves as the fiscal sponsor for the Children's Oncology Group (COG).
  
  
COG, a member of the National Cancer Institute (NCI) National Clinical Trials Network (NCTN), is the world's largest organization devoted exclusively to childhood and adolescent cancer research. COG unites over 13,500 experts in childhood cancer at more than 220 leading children's hospitals, universities, and cancer centers across the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Saudi Arabia to conduct more than 50 active clinical trials, with approximately 9,500 participants registered each year in the fight against childhood cancer.
  
  
**Position Summary**
All staff are employed through the Research Foundation. This role will be in service to the Research Foundation.
  
  
The IT Support Specialist II is responsible for delivering exceptional technical support and customer service. As a member of the IT Operations team, this position serves as the primary point of contact for end-user technology support, independently resolving the majority of end-user technical issues while enabling a secure, reliable, and productive digital workplace.
  
  
This position supports Microsoft 365 services, managed endpoint technologies, identity and access management, cloud-based business applications, collaboration platforms, and virtual desktop environments. Working closely with other members of IT Operations, the IT Support Specialist II maintains technology standards, improves the user experience, and escalates specialized infrastructure, networking, systems administration, and cybersecurity issues when appropriate.
  
  
This is a non-exempt and full-time position (40 hours per week).
  
  
The COG Research Foundation, LLC is a 100% remote employer, though some travel may be required. Employee must reside within the United States.
  
  
Full pay range for this position: $31.03 – $44.43 per hour. The typical hiring range for this position is from $31.03 (minimum) to $37.73 (midpoint) per hour. The starting pay is determined based on the candidate's knowledge, skills, experience, as well as budget availability.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
**End- User Services**

- Serve as the primary point of contact for end-user technology support while delivering exceptional customer service.
- Receive, prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests submitted through the IT service management platform and other approved support channels.
- Independently diagnose and resolve the majority of day-to-day technology issues while maintaining ownership through successful resolution.
- Troubleshoot Microsoft Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 applications, virtual desktop environments, endpoint devices, peripheral devices, remote connectivity, and approved business applications.
- Escalate infrastructure, networking, systems administration, cybersecurity, and application issues to the appropriate IT Operations team members while maintaining communication with the end user.
- Communicate technical information in a professional, user-friendly manner appropriate to the individual's level of technical knowledge.
- Document incidents, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and recommendations within the IT service management platform.
- Consistently meet established service levels while supporting a fully remote workforce.
- Promote a positive customer experience through professionalism, responsiveness, accountability, and effective follow-through.

**Microsoft 365 & Cloud Services**

- Provide technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps, Teams Phone, and other approved collaboration platforms.
- Troubleshoot authentication, licensing, synchronization, permissions, collaboration, and application-related issues.
- Administer user licenses, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and access requests in accordance with established procedures.
- Support approved cloud-based business applications and coordinate with vendors or application owners when advanced troubleshooting is required.
- Assist employees in effectively utilizing Microsoft 365 technologies to improve productivity and collaboration.
- Assist with implementing new Microsoft 365 features and services while supporting organizational technology initiatives.

**Identify & Endpoint Management**

- Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot organization-issued laptops, virtual desktop environments, mobile devices, peripheral devices, and related managed endpoint technologies.
- Administer user accounts within Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, and other approved identity platforms.
- Manage password resets, multifactor authentication, endpoint enrollment, device compliance, software deployment, and user provisioning activities.
- Coordinate technology onboarding and offboarding activities, ensuring users receive appropriate equipment, software, access, and security configuration.
- Maintain accurate technology asset inventory and equipment lifecycle records.

**Security & Compliance**

- Support organizational cybersecurity initiatives by following established security standards, policies, and procedures.
- Assist with endpoint security, identity protection, multifactor authentication, secure remote access, and endpoint compliance activities.
- Recognize, document, and promptly escalate suspected phishing attempts, malware infections, unauthorized access attempts, and other security-related incidents.
- Protect confidential, proprietary, financial, personnel, research, and other sensitive organizational information while performing assigned responsibilities.
- Participate in remediation activities and security improvement initiatives as directed.

**User Education**

- Educate users on Microsoft 365 features, collaboration tools, and approved business applications.
- Promote technology best practices that improve productivity and user effectiveness.
- Reinforce organizational cybersecurity awareness by educating users on phishing, password security, multifactor authentication, and other security practices.
- Develop and maintain user guides, quick reference materials, and knowledge base content that improves self-service capabilities.
- Encourage effective and secure use of organizational technology resources.

**Operational Support**

- Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and service documentation.
- Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements that enhance service quality, operational efficiency, and the overall user experience.
- Participate in technology deployments, software implementations, system upgrades, testing activities, and departmental initiatives.
- Collaborate effectively with systems administrators, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, vendors, and application owners.
- Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft technologies, cloud services, endpoint management, cybersecurity best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to the organization's environment.

**Other**

- Collaborate with organizational departments to understand business needs and deliver effective technology solutions.
- Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement throughout the IT Operations department.
- Participate in departmental meetings, technology planning activities, and professional development opportunities.
- May conduct occasional travel to Arcadia, CA and Los Angeles, CA if the telecommute work location is within the greater Los Angeles area.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

- Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience providing technical support for Microsoft Windows endpoint operating systems and supporting Microsoft 365 applications and services.
- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or substitute with two (2) additional years of directly related professional experience.

**Other Qualifications**

- Demonstrated experience independently diagnosing and resolving a broad range of end-user technology issues.
- Track record of supporting Microsoft 365 services, identity management, cloud-based business applications, and endpoint technologies.
- Proficiency with IT service management (ITSM) or helpdesk ticketing platforms.
- Successful history of supporting a fully remote workforce through remote administration tools, collaboration technologies, and secure remote access solutions.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and services, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 Apps.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, identity management, multifactor authentication, and endpoint management principles.
- Demonstrated experience supporting Microsoft Windows endpoint operating systems within an enterprise environment.
- Skilled in administering user accounts, licensing, permissions, and access requests.
- Experience supporting cloud-based business applications and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms.
- Experience supporting and troubleshooting endpoint technologies, including laptops, virtual desktop environments, mobile devices, peripheral devices, software deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
- Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals, DNS, VPN connectivity, wireless networking, and remote access technologies.
- Proven ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, identity, cloud application, endpoint, and connectivity issues in a timely manner.
- Excellent customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Strong organizational, documentation, and time management skills with demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to work independently while recognizing when collaboration or escalation is appropriate.
- Committed to maintaining strict confidentiality while working with organizational, personnel, financial, and research-related information.
- Flexibility to work variable hours as needed to support maintenance activities, technology deployments, and organizational priorities.
- Dedicated to staying current on Microsoft technologies, cybersecurity best practices, and emerging technologies applicable to the organization's environment.
- Ability to travel to Arcadia, CA and Los Angeles, CA if the telecommute work location is within the greater Los Angeles area.

**Specific System Experience**

- Productivity & Collaboration: Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 Apps
- Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity verification platforms
- Device Management: Microsoft Intune and Mobile Device Management (MDM) tools
- Operating Systems & Mobile Platforms: Windows, Apple iOS, and Android
- Virtualization: Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and remote desktop environments
- Remote Support Tools: Remote administration software, VPNs, and secure remote access solutions
- Enterprise Operations: IT Service Management (ITSM) systems, helpdesk ticketing tools, and SaaS/cloud-based business applications
- Networking Foundations: TCP/IP networking protocols

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience supporting Microsoft Teams phone.

**Background and Credit Checks**
Employment with COG Research Foundation, LLC is contingent upon satisfactory completion of a pre-employment background check, which may include verification of criminal history, employment history, education, and other information as permitted by law. A credit check may be required for positions where it is relevant to and permitted based on the nature of the job duties, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. All background check results will be evaluated through an individualized assessment in accordance with applicable law. COG Research Foundation, LLC is an equal opportunity employer committed to fair chance hiring practices.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
This is a unique opportunity to be on the ground floor of a critical role within a mission-driven organization. This position will play a vital part in shaping the function of the Children's Oncology Group, contributing to lasting change and making a difference in the lives of children and families impacted by cancer.
  
  
**Benefits**
Comprehensive benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), accrued Paid Time Off (PTO), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), cell phone and internet stipends, wellness stipend, paid holidays, and more. Employees who work 20 hours or more per week are eligible for these benefit options. These benefits are provided for informational purposes only and are subject to change in accordance with applicable policies and plan documents.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
COG Research Foundation, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability or medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
  
  
COG Research Foundation, LLC seeks to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Employment at COG Research Foundation, LLC is based on merit, competence, and qualifications, and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for training and advancement for all employees. COG Research Foundation, LLC is also committed to making our application process accessible to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. For further information regarding Equal Employment Opportunity, please feel free to access it here.
  
  
**ADA/Application Accommodation Statement**
COG Research Foundation, LLC is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities in the application and employment process, consistent with applicable law. Applicants who require accommodation are encouraged to make their request at the earliest opportunity to allow COG Research Foundation, LLC sufficient time to evaluate and respond to the request. Accommodation requests may be directed to the Recruitment Team at
**career@evolvehr.com**
.

title: Content Development Manager
description:
**The Company**

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we're ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.

## **Content Development Manager**

**Location: Remote** (*CA, FL, TX, MA, AZ, NY & IL*)

**About Springboard**

Springboard combines world-class online learning with high-touch human support — including dedicated mentors, career coaches, and student advisors — to help people change or advance their careers. From our AI and tech upskilling programs to our growing suite of Allied Health certification programs, we build learning experiences that help people change their lives.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a seasoned **Content Development Manager** to join our Learning Experience (LX) team. In this role, you'll own the end-to-end creation of high-quality instructional content across our programs — ranging from AI and tech courses to healthcare certification programs — helping adult learners successfully change or uplevel their careers.

Our ideal candidate is comfortable operating at both 30,000 feet and 3 feet: someone who can flex between being in the details while building towards the bigger picture. You might be asked to conceptualize and build a new course end-to-end to drive ambitious learner outcomes, build relationships and work with SME/instructors to shape their presentational content week-over-week, or dive into the details to do a careful proofreading pass of written content. Our ideal candidate possesses a “learning producer” mindset: you understand how content presented live should support and connect to content consumed asynchronously, and the strengths of different formats and modalities.

We’re looking for someone who brings an eye to detail, obsession with high-quality content and learning experiences, and creative range to everything they build.

  

**What You'll Do**

- Own the full lifecycle of course content development across multiple modalities. We’re looking for someone who has a wide range of content development experience across written learning materials, instructional video, live sessions (eg., webinars), audio content, and beyond.
- Act as a “Learning Producer” for new courses – developing a vision for both synchronous and asynchronous learning components of courses – and executing on that vision.
- Write, edit, and proofread instructional content to a high standard of clarity, accuracy, and learner-friendliness, leveraging AI tools.
- Build relationships and collaborate closely with subject matter experts, instructors, and presenters to refine, elevate and gamify lectures and presentations.
- Leverage AI tools to accelerate and enhance content development workflows.
- Partner cross-functionally with project managers, the LX team, client-facing teams, and other internal stakeholders to ensure content meets business objectives and launch timelines.
- Maintain and continuously improve content quality standards across the team.

**What You Bring**

- 8–10 years of experience in learning design, content development, and/or course development.
- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of course creation — from concept through final production.
- Content development experience across modalities: written content, video production, live/webinar facilitation, learning games, audio/podcast production, etc.
- Exceptional writing, proofreading, and editing skills. You are the colleague people send drafts to because you have an impeccable editing eye.
- Proven ability to work with SMEs and instructors to sharpen and refine their material – and translate it into course elements.
- An outcomes focus: experience designing and building learning experiences attached to ambitious KPIs.
- Ability to independently manage your own project timelines.
- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to support content development.
- A portfolio or examples of work you've built and are proud of.
- Experience developing AI, tech, or data courses OR background in healthcare or Allied Health instructional content.
- People management experience is not required, but is a bonus.

**Why Springboard**

Why this moment, why Springboard?

If you want to own something and help build something that matters, this is it. Our courses serve real, tangible needs of individuals and employers: people are looking to change or uplevel their careers to improve their lives, and employers have talent shortages that aren’t simply a trend, but a genuine crisis. This is the problem we exist to solve. If you want to move away from building products that are "nice-to-have" and start developing mission-critical solutions that fundamentally change how people upskill, reskill, and get hired, let’s talk.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

**California Privacy Rights Notice for Job Applicants**

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), Springboard is required to inform California residents who are job applicants about the categories of personal information we collect about you and the purposes for which we will use this information. This notice contains disclosures required by the CCPA and applies only to personal information that is subject to the CCPA.

title: Offensive Security Training Content Developer
description:
**Whether you’re an experienced professional or just getting started, your contributions matter at Fortra. If you’re passionate about tackling meaningful challenges alongside talented team members committed to helping each other succeed, all while having lots of fun, we want to hear from you. We offer competitive benefits and salaries, personal and professional development opportunities, flexibility, and much more!**

Fortra’s Offensive Security portfolio brings together industry-leading adversary simulation technology, offensive security expertise, and hands-on training. Following the addition of Zero-Point Security to Fortra, we are expanding our training capabilities to help offensive security professionals develop practical, real-world skills across red teaming, adversary simulation, and penetration testing.  
  
We are looking for an Offensive Security Training Content Developer to help build and evolve Fortra’s offensive security training portfolio. This is a hands-on technical role combining offensive security expertise, technical education, lab development, and content creation.  
  
You will be responsible for maintaining and improving the Zero-Point Security Red Team Operations courses, supporting and expanding Cobalt Strike training and certification content, and developing new courses around emerging offensive security techniques and Fortra technologies.  
  
You should enjoy understanding offensive tradecraft in depth, explaining complex concepts clearly, and turning technical knowledge into practical exercises that allow students to learn by doing.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

  

- Maintain and continuously improve Red Team Operations, Cobalt Strike, and related offensive security training content, ensuring it reflects current tradecraft, product capabilities, and recommended operator practices.
- Design and develop new courses, modules, hands-on exercises, assessments, certifications, and learning paths for Fortra’s offensive security training portfolio.
- Research modern adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, translating them into safe, realistic, and authorized training scenarios.
- Create, document, test, and maintain practical lab environments - including supporting infrastructure, scripts, configurations, and resources - to ensure exercises are accurate, reproducible, reliable, and achieve their intended learning outcomes.
- Write clear, structured technical learning materials, including lessons, walkthroughs, lab guides, reference documentation, quizzes, and exercises for audiences with varied experience levels.
- Collaborate with Zero-Point Security experts, Cobalt Strike engineers and researchers, product teams, and other stakeholders to turn research, tooling, and product capabilities into effective training.
- Gather and incorporate feedback from students, instructors, customers, support teams, and internal stakeholders to improve course quality and the overall learning experience.
- Help shape the training roadmap by identifying skills gaps, emerging techniques, new technologies, and opportunities for new courses or certifications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
